title: Stay in Bath
subtitle: StayinBath.org is owned and run by BIGHA, the Bath Independent Guest House Association. We are a voluntary membership organisation made up of over 100 guesthouses, small hotels and self catering accommodation, all working together to offer overnight visitors to Bath the best possible experience.
bodyContent: Who are we? StayinBath.org is owned and run by BIGHA, the Bath Independent Guest House Association. We are a voluntary membership organisation made up of over 100 guesthouses, small hotels and self catering accommodation, all working together to offer overnight visitors to Bath the best possible experience. StayinBath.org offers you: A choice of independently owned B&Bs, small hotels or self-catering accommodation We have accommodation to suit every visitor to Bath, whether you: Are on holiday or on business Are on your own, with your family, travelling with a friend or in a group Want the bustle of the city centre or the tranquillity of the countryside Need somewhere which caters for mobility, visual or hearing problems Need somewhere with parking or with access to public transport links Want to bring your pets We can help you to discover: Bath’s rich history and architecture Bath’s wonderful independent restaurants offering a whole host of diverse cuisine Bath’s eclectic range of shops Bath’s amazing Festivals’ calendar Prestigious sporting events How are we run? BIGHA is run by an elected committee, all of whom are volunteers, working tirelessly to support and market Bath’s independent hotels, guest houses and self-catering accommodation. Why should you use StayinBath? All of our members live in Bath and North East Somerset. We have a wealth of local knowledge which you will be able to call upon to get the best out of Bath. In return, unlike when you book with another OTA ( Online Travel Agent) you are safe in the knowledge that you are contributing to the local economy of Bath so we can keep maintaining it for years to come as a great place to live, work – and visit Why should you trust us? We have been working together for over 20 years to ensure the highest standards are maintained by our members. All members have to adhere to the health and safety legislation as set by local and national government, including fire risk assessment, health & safety, food hygiene certificates ( where appropriate) and 3 rd party liability insurance. Many have attained external quality standards for their properties which are visible on line All properties are described with clear accurate information, a user-friendly booking procedure, terms and condition and access statement. Run by owners who are dedicated to providing quality accommodation. We also consider feedback from review and travel websites during this process.

title: Manor Farm House
subtitle: Welcome to Manor Farm House! Manor Farm House is a gorgeous country Manor near Bath in the heart of rural Somerset tucked away along a quiet lane in the village of Norton St Philip.
bodyContent: Our self catering accommodation comprises of two separate, spacious holiday lets for families or alternatively one large let for a group of families and friends. We have separate entrances, which we hope is reassuring in the current Covid 19 climate. The Manor is a 15 minute drive from the beautiful city of Bath, close to Longleat Safari Park, scenic rivers for wild swimming, paddle boarding and boating, wonderful walks to our local cider pub and great cycling country. We have a variety of National Trust properties and gardens close by, Hauser and Wirth in Bruton, Frome outdoor markets and lots more to keep you happily distracted. West Wing The West Wing accommodates 4-5 guests and provides stylish and comfortable accommodation for families and small groups. The accommodation comprises 2 en-suite bedrooms, one of which has a four poster bed, a spacious sitting room with four large sunny windows and a fully fitted 'secret kitchen' with double oven, dishwasher, microwave and stylish Smeg fridge. Prices start from £554 for a 3 night break. Monks Retreat Our apartment sleeps 4-6 plus cot and is entirely self-contained and is positioned on the top floor of this historic manor house. The private side gateway guides you through a courtyard garden to an elm studded medieval door. The staircase leads you on to the recently refurbished apartment in the vast attic space, lovely old oak beams and beautiful views of the rolling countryside. Prices start from £554 for a 3 night break. The Manor Wing The Manor Wing accommodates 10-15 guests and is perfect for family celebrations, birthdays and anniversary's, wedding groups, girlie gatherings and business meetings. Manor Farm House has a calming, relaxing atmosphere, the self catering accommodation in the wonderfully imposing Queen Anne and Tudor country house is spacious, comfortable and tastefully decorated. Prices for 10 guests staying 2 nights start from £1374 at weekends.

title: Pigwig Country Cottage
subtitle: Pigwig Cottage is a cosy, detached, single storey, spacious two bedroom self catering cottage at sleeping up to 4 or 5 with an additional bed.
bodyContent: Pigwig Cottage is a lovely detached, single storey, spacious two bedroom self catering cottage at Bradford on Avon, near Bath sleeping up to 4 or 5 with an additional bed. Each bedroom can be a double or twin ensuring very flexible accommodation for families or friends. It is situated in a semi-rural location just outside Bradford-on-Avon in a small group with two other cottages and B&B rooms in converted farm buildings. The B&B rooms can be used as additional ensuite rooms if you need more bedrooms. Being single storey it is popular with less mobile guests and those with young children. The cottage overlooks agricultural fields to the rear and a grass lawn to the front. This charming cottage features a fully equipped kitchen, log burning stove, exposed wooden beams, electric heating, wi-fi internet access, Freeview television with DVD player, washer/dryer aswell as a BBQ and patio. Bed linens are provided. There is also a games room, children play area and games field. Our pets and other free ranging animals include two Shetland ponies, two over friendly English Setters, two black cats and various hens and ducks. Although currently not dog friendly we have Cow Byre 1 or 2 which are. Bath is a pleasant short train journey taking you right to the town centre meaning you dont have to navigate the tricky one way system and then find a car park! The George at Woolley is a 10 minute walk firstly across a grassed field so bring your wellies if it is wet. There are lots of other good restaurants and pubs in Bradford on Avon and the surrounding area. Bradford on Avon is a 20 minute walk into town. Lastly we offer 30% off day tickets for nearby Longleat and 25% for Cheddar Gorge and Caves We hope you will choose us for your stay near Bath. *Late Availability Discounts’
tagline: Pigwig Cottage is a cosy, detached, single storey, spacious two bedroom self catering cottage

title: Hawkins of Bath
subtitle: Hawkins of Bath, your first choice for a luxury stay in the beautiful city of Bath.
bodyContent: Hawkins of Bath, your first choice for a luxury stay in the beautiful city of Bath. This elegant Victorian villa has been renovated by its present owners and will provide you with the perfect home from home during your stay in this world heritage site. Offering a spacious off road car park at the rear of the property ‘Hawkins’ provides a perfect base for discovering Bath and it’s many surrounding areas. Located just under a mile from the Royal Crescent, Hawkins of Bath is a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city. Large, airy and spacious rooms await you at this beautiful, boutique style Guest House. Access to the city is via a level walk, either along the road and through Royal Victoria Park or along the banks of the River Avon. Alternatively you could hop on a bus nearby and in 5-10 minutes you will be in the city centre.
tagline: Hawkins of Bath, your first choice for a luxury stay in the beautiful city of Bath.

title: The Mumfords & Sons Story
subtitle: The Mumford & Sons Story recreates the epic rise of the foot-stomping folk-rock giants who took the world by storm.
bodyContent: The Mumford & Sons Story recreates the epic rise of the foot-stomping folk-rock giants who took the world by storm. Four powerhouse musicians, decked out in waistcoats, skinny jeans, and some glorious beards, deliver a barnstorming celebration of Mumford & Sons’ unmistakable sound and unstoppable journey to global fame. Get ready to dance, clap, and holler as this electric quartet takes you on a whirlwind ride through the band’s first two albums—Sigh No More and Babel—from gritty West London bars to their legendary Glastonbury triumph. Packed with all the anthems you love—Little Lion Man, I Will Wait, The Cave,— now featuring songs from all five albums - Delta, Rushmere, Believe and more - this show is pure festival energy bottled up for an unforgettable night. A stomp, a roar, a singalong celebration…this is one party you don’t want to miss!
tagline: The Mumford & Sons Story

title: An Evening of Opera at Dunster Castle
subtitle: Wild Arts are returning to the garden to bring you an evening of musical hits. Bring your picnics and enjoy a magical summer's evening of opera highlights.
bodyContent: Wild Arts return to Dunster Castle with an evening of Operatic and Musical Hits. Semi-staged by director Guido Martin-Brandis and woven into a new narrative full of dramatic intrigue, jealousy, comedy, idealism, and true love – follow the characters as they travel through 75 minutes of music. From arias and scenes by Handel, Mozart, Rossini, and Britten, to the songs of Richard Rodgers and Stephen Sondheim. Performed by four fabulous singers and a world-class string quintet. You are welcome to arrive from 5.30pm to set up your picnic on the lawn and open the bubbly. Bring whatever you need to make yourselves comfortable - picnic rugs, tables, chairs and hampers are all welcome. "Let me tell you that Wild Arts’ opera evenings are of a breathtakingly high, ROH-level musical standard – a gorgeous quintet of musicians and a most cunning choice of excerpts, mischievously well acted. I’d follow them anywhere." -Libby Purves Tickets General admission £35 Young people aged under 25 £15 There is a discount of 15% for groups of 6 or more people. Timings Gardens open for picnic from 6.15pm The Performance begins at 7pm with a 1 hour interval for picnics. The evening will end at approximately 9.30pm Free parking is included with your ticket. Only a limited number of tickets will be offered for sale, so please book early.
tagline: Wild Arts are returning to the garden

title: Somerset Safari at Noah's Ark Zoo Farm
subtitle: Back by popular demand, Somerset Safari returns at Noah's Ark Zoo Farm - an exclusive after-hours adventure designed for the whole family.
bodyContent: Back by popular demand, Somerset Safari returns at Noah's Ark Zoo Farm - an exclusive after-hours adventure designed for the whole family. Visitors are invited to experience the Zoo in a completely different light across selected evenings on Saturday 6th June, or Saturday 4th July, or Saturday 1st August, from 5:30pm to 8:30pm. Guests can explore at their own pace, enjoy the unique evening atmosphere, and discover memorable moments around every corner. The event offers a packed programme of entertainment, including face painting, exclusive animal talks and feeds, up-close mini encounters, and a variety of delicious food options. Every pound raised from the event helps to support vital conservation work.

title: DoubleTree by Hilton Cadbury House
subtitle: Great motorway links M5 junction 20 & 21 Bristol International Airport only 12 minutes away Bristol City Centre only 25 minutes away. With local access to Cheddar Gorge and Mendip AONB only 45 minutes away.
bodyContent: Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Cadbury House, the South West’s finest four-star boutique hotel and spa. An enchanting venue set within rolling English countryside, Cadbury House is the ideal backdrop for your special occasion whether a wedding, private party, business event, spa break or dining experience. With truly breath-taking views across North Somerset and the Bristol Channel, Cadbury House effortlessly combines old and new, with the traditional country house and the elegant boutique-style hotel. There is also an onsite Marco Pierre White Steakhouse Bar & Grill, an award-winning health club and a renowned spa. The hotel offers 132 luxury bedrooms including suites, on-site parking and excellent transport access meaning guests can enjoy the facilities for both business and pleasure. Please note from May 1 st , 2022 overnight parking will be chargeable at £5.00 per vehicle. Corporate customers are also well catered for with 12 meeting rooms, multiple breakout areas, and a dedicated conference team on hand. Whether you are hosting a small business meeting to a multi-day conference, DoubleTree by Hilton Cadbury House does not disappoint as a destination location for business needs.
tagline: The South West’s finest four-star boutique hotel and spa.

title: Percy Place
subtitle: Period holiday apartment in Bath sleeping 6 people at walking distance from the city centre with free on street parking.
bodyContent: Percy Place is a holiday apartment in a Grade II listed Georgian house in the City of Bath. The house used to be the home of Rev. William Jay, one of the most eminent English Congregationalist preachers of Regency England who used to preach in the Argyle Chapel in Bath at the end of 1700s. We like to make our guests feel at home and highly valued. The original Georgian features of the building are enhanced by the stylish decor of the rooms such as antiques, trinkets and period furniture. At the same time, free wi-fi and a recently refurbished kitchen offer modern comfort. Both the town and the countryside are on our doorstep. We are just a few minutes walk from the city centre between the up and coming ‘Artisan Quarter’ bristling with local independent shops, and Larkhall village, a pretty quarter with a local butcher, a deli, a theatre and a few restaurants. We are also very close to the Kennet & Avon Canal at the back of Kensington Meadows. The view of the countryside and back garden from the back of the house is relaxing and inspiring.
tagline: Period holiday apartment in Bath sleeping 6 people at walking distance from the city centre

title: Lisa O’Neill + Support
subtitle: Lisa O’Neill returns to the stage with songs that cut straight to the heart: fierce, poetic and steeped in the tradition of Irish storytelling.
bodyContent: One of the most arresting voices in contemporary folk, she brings her raw, luminous songwriting to Komedia Bath for an intimate evening drawn from her forthcoming EP and across her celebrated catalogue. O’Neill’s music carries a rare stillness, haunting renditions of old songs sit alongside sharply observed portraits of modern life, protest anthems, and moments of quiet wonder. Her voice, unmistakable in its depth and honesty, has made her a five-time BBC Folk Award nominee and a standout presence on stages across Ireland, the UK and beyond.
tagline: Lisa O’Neill returns to the stage

The Somerset Chamber of Commerce and Visit Somerset are delighted to invite members to our Future of Hospitality Business Brunch, an inspiring event exploring how the hospitality sector is adapting in changing times.

We are thrilled to welcome Ethan Davids, Owner and Founder of the Chickpea Group. In just a short period, Ethan and his team have successfully opened several pubs , proving that the next generation’s passion for hospitality is alive and well.

Despite the challenges faced by the industry post-pandemic—shifts in social habits, disposable income, and generational preferences—Chickpea has bucked the trend. What makes them different? How did they achieve growth when so many struggled? Ethan will share his journey, insights, and lessons learned.

This brunch also offers a fantastic opportunity to network with businesses from across Somerset, exchange ideas, and gain inspiration for your own ventures.

Weds 4th Feb at the Manor House Inn, Shepton Mallet

title: Henge House - Sarsen Apartment
subtitle: Ideal for families, groups of friends or business visitors who want a bit of space.
bodyContent: The apartment has an elegant kitchen-living room perfect for relaxing on the sofa in front of the large smart TV, enjoying a morning coffee at the breakfast bar or tucking into a delicious supper at the dining table. The fully-equipped kitchen has an induction hob, fan oven, microwave and dining sets for at least six guests. A separate washing machine and tumble drier can be found down the hall in the utility room. Guests can choose between the master bedroom with ensuite or the second bedroom. Both rooms have super-king-size ‘zip and link’ beds that can be split to create twin beds when wanted. The living room sofa can be folded out to provide an additional double bed. A second shower and bath can be found in the family bathroom. The apartment is decorated in a contemporary but classic style using only top quality furnishing and appliances. It has underfloor heating, is ‘A energy rated’ and has solar PV and hot water. Super-fast broadband and Wifi is available throughout. Off street parking is available outside the apartment building, Henge House, which has CCTV, RFID locks and video access for guests.

title: Mill Meadow Eco Lodge
subtitle: Mill Meadow offers you a unique holiday experience in luxury eco wooden lodges and cottages with completely flexible arrival and departure days, an Electric Vehicle Charging Station free of charge, tranquil fishing lake, private hot tubs, warm welcomes for your dogs and a local pub.
bodyContent: Mill Meadow is a gated, private and secure destination nestled in green countryside at the foot of the Quantock Hills surrounded by a perfect natural landscape which provides a stunning backdrop to your stay close to Taunton in the heart of stunning Somerset. Everyone is welcome to our range of self catering options which can accommodate up to 74 guests, across 10 homes. As a family business we can offer helpful advice on places to visit and things to do during your stay. We communicate with our guests from the moment of booking and are available to answer any questions no matter how small. Relax in your hot tub, light the BBQ, enjoy fishing for free in our tranquil lake, sit, read or paint in our lakeside summerhouse, walk the beautiful local lanes and picturesque Quantock Hills, bring together family and friends for special celebrations, wedding accommodation, birthdays, hen weekends, honeymoons or simply a relaxing break amongst all that makes Somerset special. Indulge in holistic therapies, order vintage teas or a chef to cook for you. Open all year round, our super fast Wi-Fi makes your wooden lodge idea to "work from home" Our eco lodges are accessible for our less mobile guests and those with additional requirements and we love dogs too. Mill Meadow is conveniently situated close to Taunton mainline station and the M5 motorway. Bristol and Exeter International airports are within a one-hour drive. We offer a minimum of three night stays except in Goldcrest Lodge, which has a two night minimum stay So visit us soon and make your own 'Mill Meadow Memories' Accessibility: Ground floor accessible wet rooms and bedrooms in many lodges Access to local support services including equipment hire and hydro therapy pool Children & Infants: Children welcome Travel Cot & Highchair free of charge Pet Information: Dogs accepted in most lodges, other pets by arrangement Establishment Features: Countryside location Family run business Families welcome Groups welcome Free Superfast WiFi Eco Friendly Utilities included Leisure Facilities: Private Coarse Fishing on site Hot Tub available on most lodges Special provisions for cyclists Special provisions for walkers BBQ's Golf courses and other facilities nearby Parking & Tranport: Free parking Close to main rail/bus stations and road network Room & Unit Features: Dishwasher Washing machine Drying facilities DVD Player Free View TV Fridge/Freezer Linen and towels (not for hot tub) provided Ironing facilities Hair dryers Please note: Visit Taunton cannot accept any responsibility for matters arising between a customer and the accommodation provider. title: Old Stables
subtitle: The Old Stables is created from a stone built-stable block dating from the 1840’s.
bodyContent: It is located in the beautiful Georgian village of Freshford which lies at the junction of the Frome and Avon valleys in the southern Cotswolds. There are some wonderful walks to local pubs following the riverside and canals. All just 15 minutes from Bath by car but the secret of this location is the 9 minute train journey to Bath from the village station, just a short stroll from the cottages. A three bedroom cottage (two king and one twin-bed)with a fully equipped kitchen opening onto a dining room There is a separate living room with TV/DVD and two large leather couches . The living room has large patio doors that open up onto the courtyard area. The Old Stables can accommodate 6 people. This cottage has: Three bedrooms (two king size and one with twin beds) One family bathroom Living room with Freeview TV/DVD two large leather couches Dining table with 6 chairs Kitchen equipped with all cookware,dishwasher and washing machine Iron/Ironing board. Hairdryers , bed linen and towels are all provided in the bedrooms.Welcome pack of tea, coffee, sugar, milk, bread, butter, eggs and bacon. Free WiFi. Neighbourhood overview Freshford is a beautiful ancient village with a wonderful pub just a few minutes walk from the cottage( The Inn at Freshford) that serves restaurant quality food and all the local beers and ciders.They have an excellent fully stocked( from wine to organic humus!)community shop that also has a good quality cafe that serves lunch. There is also a local doctors surgery. The village is nestled at the junction of the Frome and Avon valleys . The Kennet and Avon canal is a 15 minute walk from the cottage. Getting around You don’t need a car to stay in the cottage. The village station is a few minutes walk away. Trains are hourly off peak and thrice hourly at peak times. Bath 9 mins, Bristol 22 mins. London Padington to Bath Spa 1.5 hours Bath Spa to Freshford 9 minutes Bath Spa to Freshford “ https://www.thetrainline.com/train-times/bath-spa-to-freshford ” Freshford to Bath Spa “ https://www.thetrainline.com/train-times/freshford-to-bath-spa ” There is also a local bus service to all the adjacent villages and Bath. The cottage has two parking spaces suitable for one medium and one small car or a single large SUV. Other things to note If you are a runner or keep fit enthusiast the owner is a qualified Personal Trainer (Bath Uni) with much Marathon and half marathon experience. She specialises in Ladies training. Please let us know if you would like guided running or some Personal Fitness training
tagline: The Old Stables is created from a stone built-stable block dating from the 1840’s.

title: Lady Maisery with Jimmy Aldridge & Sid Goldsmith
subtitle: Lady Maisery with Jimmy Aldridge & Sid Goldsmith present Wakefire: A Midsummer Celebration
bodyContent: Lady Maisery with Jimmy Aldridge & Sid Goldsmith present Wakefire: A Midsummer Celebration Having bewitched audiences annually with their much-loved wintertime show, two of the most engaging and inventive acts on the English folk scene return with their hotly anticipated next alchemic collaboration: an essential incantation to the summertime. Award winning trio Lady Maisery (Hannah James, Rowan Rheingans and Hazel Askew) have for nearly a decade produced “some of the most exquisite, thrilling work in the English folk scene” (The Guardian). The beguiling musical partnership of Jimmy Aldridge & Sid Goldsmith complete the powerful line-up. With more folk songs collected about the month of May than any other time apart from Christmas, the charismatic supergroup embark on a journey to mark this season in song. There is of course morris, mayday and magic. There is also ritual, rave and cider with Rosie. There are countryside cuckoos and city foxes. There is fear for our warming planet alongside the promise of ripening fruit. As with their extremely popular wintertime show, the Awake Arise midsummer offering is a multi-layered, surprising and essential incantation to long summer days and effervescent nights.
tagline: Lady Maisery with Jimmy Aldridge & Sid Goldsmith present Wakefire

title: Mendip Mini Fest at Mendip Basecamp | 24th to 26th July
subtitle: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends!
bodyContent: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends! Set in an award-winning adventure campsite in the Mendip Hills, Somerset, guests can enjoy off-grid camping, campfires, and woodland adventures. At the on-site Mendip Activity Centre, guests also have access to more than 20 outdoor adventures, from snowsports and archery to frisbee golf and watersports. Across the weekends, Basecamp will offer outdoor workshops, circus skills, children’s storytelling, live acoustic music, and Sunday morning yoga, with Saturday nights bringing the Bandwagon stage to life with headline local bands. From Friday 24th July to Sunday 26th July, enjoy live music from local singer-songwriter Daisy Chapman, who has appeared on the stages of numerous worldwide tours and festivals including Glastonbury, 2000Trees, Migration Festival, and Breminale. Also set to perform is Basecamp's headline band, Supervision, on Saturday night - a Rock`n`Soul night for fans of Stevie Wonder, Queen and Journey. Dream of playing a festival stage? Now you can! For the chance to perform a 30-minute opening set, enter Basecamp's Mendip Mini Fest competition. Simply complete the online form, and upload your performance video to apply.
tagline: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests.

title: Hundred Watt Club
subtitle: Roll Up! Roll Up! The risqué, raunchy & ridiculous people of Hundred Watt Club make their Bath debut with a glittering and glorious evening of burlesque, vaudeville & comedy!
bodyContent: Step into a world of old-time glamour and new-time wit, with a seductive, sizzling, and sometimes very silly cast hand-selected by Hundred Watt Club’s Lena Lenman. This show is a no-holds-barred, full-throttle journey into the wonderful world of sparkling show-people, circus spectacles & salacious superstars. Strap in for a wild and wonderful ride! Hundred Watt Club is proud to be one of the longest-running burlesque revues in the UK…Expect the unexpected, but gear up for a good old-fashioned, very grown-up evening of variety entertainment. Forget your troubles and come to the cabaret! Content advisories : Strong Language, partial nudity, adult themes, flashing lights, loud noises. What the critics say : ‘Whole-heartedly recommended for those with dubious morals!’ Facebook Review ‘Harking back to the gin drenched halcyon days of a grimy Berlin nightclub in the 1930s, Hundred Watt Club sparkles, fizzles and shines brightly on a dark night.’ Fringe Review (Brighton) ‘Coarse and unpleasant…for coarse and unpleasant people.’ Seetickets review.
tagline: Roll Up! Roll Up! The risqué, raunchy & ridiculous people of Hundred Watt Club

title: Old Dairy
subtitle: The Old Dairy is a spacious and tastefully furnished fully equipped cottage set in quiet, peaceful surroundings.
bodyContent: The Old Dairy is a spacious and tastefully furnished fully equipped holiday cottage set in peaceful rural surroundings close to Bath, Bristol & Wells. Because the cottage is double glazed, has full oil fired central heating and a log fireplace it is cosy and ideal for winter breaks. The cottage is on ground floor level and has no internal steps or stairs. It has a private patio area with garden furniture and a rotary washing line. The cottage has adjacent safe parking. Free use of all our facilities – Boules Court, Hot Tub, Sauna, Mini Gym, Barbecue Hut and Wi-Fi. Booking Old Dairy Fully flexible short breaks are available all year round. title: Mendip Mini Fests at Mendip Basecamp | 31st July to 2nd August
subtitle: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends!
bodyContent: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends! Set in an award-winning adventure campsite in the Mendip Hills, Somerset, guests can enjoy off-grid camping, campfires, and woodland adventures. At the on-site Mendip Activity Centre, guests also have access to more than 20 outdoor adventures, from snowsports and archery to frisbee golf and watersports. Across the weekends, Basecamp will offer outdoor workshops, circus skills, children’s storytelling, live acoustic music, and Sunday morning yoga, with Saturday nights bringing the Bandwagon stage to life with headline local bands. On Friday 31st July South West-based Sam Evans will bring uplifting soul, folk, and pop sounds for a warm, feel-good performance. No stranger to the stage, Sam has over 1,000 live performances to his name, and has played on the BBC Introducing set at Glastonbury. On Saturday 1st August, Aardvarks, formerly known as Razzomo, will take over with their high-energy world-folk fusion performance, delivering a lively headline set guaranteed to get the crowd moving. Dream of playing a festival stage? Now you can! For the chance to perform a 30-minute opening set, enter Basecamp's Mendip Mini Fest competition. Simply complete the online form, and upload your performance video to apply.
tagline: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests.

title: Doreen Doreen
subtitle: Step into the vibrant world of Doreen Doreen, where every performance is a kaleidoscope of glitter, glamour, and unbridled entertainment.
bodyContent: Born in the heart of Bristol's eclectic music scene, Doreen Doreen emerged in 1982 as a dynamic force of creativity and flair. Forget everything you know about typical 10-piece cover bands; Doreen Doreen is a breed apart. Our lineup boasts some of Bristol's finest musical talent, delivering a red-hot backline that sets the stage on fire. Upfront, a cacophony of voices—ranging from angelic to rock god—takes you on a wild ride of harmonies that teeter on the edge of chaos, but always land squarely on fabulous. But it's not just about the music—it's the unexpected twists and turns that define a Doreen Doreen performance. We're the masters of incongruity, seamlessly blending Abba with Queen, Eurythmics with Erasure, and even Adele with The Beatles. It's a musical journey you won't find anywhere else. Prepare to be swept away by the sheer fun, mayhem, and frivolity of a night in our company. From start to finish, we guarantee you'll be on your feet, dancing like there's no tomorrow. And when the music finally fades, you'll find yourself craving more, already planning your next Doreen Doreen experience. With Doreen Doreen, seeing is believing. Join us for a spectacle like no other, and discover why our fans keep coming back for more.
tagline: Step into the vibrant world of Doreen Doreen

title: Myrtle House
subtitle: Myrtle House is a spacious family home that is well situated in a central, rural location. The house is et in its own land, surrounded by gardens, a paddock, and fields, which are usually grazed by cows and calves. It is a great base for a relaxing vacation.
bodyContent: Myrtle House is a spacious family home that is well situated in a central, rural location. The house is set in its own land, surrounded by gardens, a paddock, and fields, which are usually grazed by cows and calves. It is a great base for a relaxing vacation. Accommodation is available as two units, which can be rented singly or together, but if one of the units has been rented, the other will not be available for the duration of that let. The first unit - the house - can comfortably sleep seven people upstairs, in two double bedrooms, a twin and a single bedroom; a cot and highchair are available on request for younger guests. The second unit – the annex- is designed to accommodate disabled visitors, including those who cannot transfer from a wheelchair. It will sleep a maximum of four people in a pair of twin beds and a sofa bed that will sleep two; all at ground floor level .It can be used by anyone; however the prime focus is to allow physically incapacitated persons to have a good holiday accompanied by their carer and /or their family. The home is ideal accommodation for those wishing to explore this beautiful part of England, by car, bicycle, or on foot. The property is within easy reach of many country or coastal attractions. It is situated 3 miles west of the small and attractive market town of Ilminster and 5 miles from the Devon border. The Jurassic coast is about twenty miles, with Cheddar, Glastonbury, and Wells a little further in the opposite direction. West Somerset and Exmoor are also easily reached. The immediate area around the house is blessed with fine old country houses and gardens, many attractive hamstone villages with their equally attractive pubs, and the beautiful Blackdown Hills, designated an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.
tagline: Myrtle House is a spacious family home that is well situated in a central, rural location.

title: Hide on the Hill
subtitle: We currently offer our two beautiful bed & breakfast rooms for you to enjoy and the chance to relax away from the bustle - located on the margins of the Avalon marshes near Glastonbury in Somerset.
bodyContent: The Orchard room to the north provides a vista to the Mendip Hills. It has a luxurious king size Hypnos hideaway bed with luxury cotton sheets. (17m 2 ) The Garden room faces south with views down to the levels and is decorated to enhance the luminosity of the ​Somerset sky into the room. It is a large twin room that can accommodate a child up to 5 years for additional charges. (23m 2 ) Facilities Both rooms are brand new and have large en-suite bathrooms with big showers, towels and soaps. Each room has free internet access and we have decides not to provide televisions as many guests said they ​already had good 4G signals on their network preferring to use their own devices. Facilities include a tray to make tea and coffee replenished each day, a hairdryer is available, toiletries in the en-suite to be left for the next guests . Your Stay CHECK-IN is from 4pm on the day of arrival. It really helps if you give us an approximate time to make your welcome great. You will be greeted in the conservatory with a welcoming drink and chat about how to chill after your drive. Please note that any balance on the stay must be settled after you have settled in. BREAKFAST is served between 8am and 9.30am in the dining room, but should you require an early breakfast please let us know. Later breakfasts will be in the form of a convenient breakfast in a bag (no beans obviously!). You can relax in the dining room with the fantastic views up until 12am for the long stay guests. Our continental and full English breakfast are standard and you will be able to upgrade, for an additional charge, to a selection of special breakfasts like kedgeree, smoked salmon, chilly rice , pancakes and Goan curry on fried coconut bread, all of which have to be booked in advance. ​We strive to be organic as possible with named local produce and our own garden produce. Our excellent bread is from a local artisan baker, meat from a small Gloucester Old Spot pig farm, and jams and organic trout from a aquaponics. Depending upon the weather you can have a continental breakfast tray outside on the terrace or in one of the garden retreats. CHECK-OUT is by 11am and some guests are requested to settle any additional charges along with the keys after breakfast. We would appreciate your feedback and suggestions. PARKING is close to the house and free Fully complaint fire and smoke detectors are present for your additional safety which means you can only smoke in the designated area outside the building. ENERGY USE Hide on The Hill uses sustainable energy including a pellet boiler, Powerdiverter, loads of insulation and solar panels which help to reduce the impact of the travellers carbon footprint. Laundry is washed during daylight hours to utilise the suns energy and for longer staying guests sheets are changed after 3 days. Towels are removed and replaced if left in the basket but otherwise left for further use. Heating is on every morning and evening and is controlled by thermostats. Additional hypo allergenic bed linen can be provided if requested. THE GARDEN has many quiet spots for lazing in the sun on deckchairs or siting by the caravan to read and make yourself a cup of tea. There is a living willow spiral and firepit with a basket of free wood to use in the early evening. AMBIENCE at our hilltop hide will become obvious on your first walk around the gardens and we believe that you'll value the peace and quiet so we decided to not have televisions in the rooms. We would request that music is moderated by 10pm please . Many guests use their tablets for streaming which is fine but please turn down the volume thereafter. PETS are, at present,not able to be part of your stay but those with registered guide dogs will be considered if we know from you how to best manage the arrangement. WALKERS AND CYCLISTS are most welcome with a range of facilities to help including a drying room, outside boot area to change walking gear, a small jet wash for muddy bikes, a bike wall to repair bikes and a lockup for your bike

title: Oak Tree Cottage
subtitle: Oak Tree Cottage has been created over Winter 2015/2016 and is now a lovely light two bedroomed, two bathroomed holiday home.
bodyContent: It has a ground floor twin bedroom and bathroom, a lounge/diner with separate kitchen and a second floor with huge double bedroom and en-suite bathroom. It also has the benefit of an extra “snug” style TV room – perfect for children to watch TV and play games. A vaulted ceiling theme runs through Oak Tree’s 1st floor bedroom and it has lovely roof windows with views. Outside of the cottage is a shared lawned paddock and an open air solar heated swimming pool. There is plenty of on-site parking available at the farm and our own little farm shop/butchery for all your breakfast needs! Next door to Oak Tree is its “sister” property, Walnut Tree.

title: Broad Street Townhouse
subtitle: A boutique hotel in the heart of Bath, with coffee shop and speakeasy style cocktail bar
bodyContent: Broad Street Townhouse is a new boutique city-centre bolthole – offering eleven impeccably designed bedrooms and a speakeasy bar, The Blind Pig. Guests arrive via the original shopfront façade, greeted by monochrome Victorian inspired bordered tiling, high ceilings, sash windows and exposed timber staircases – leading to the eleven en-suite bedrooms set over three floors. The beautiful interiors offer a laid-back and luxurious home-from-home – statement pieces of furniture and individual artwork are found throughout the bedrooms, each with king-size beds, decorated with soft shades and leafy green plants and come complete with complimentary Bramley botanicals and sustainable bamboo amenities in the bathrooms. Each room comes furnished with every modern traveller’s needs – Wi-Fi, Roberts Radios, rain head showers, mini-fridges, and Smart TVs.

title: New Forest Escapes
subtitle: The New Forest is just two hours south-west of London. The National Park is a wilderness of heathland, ancient woodland, river valley and coast.
bodyContent: Great for a relaxing escape and a perfect New Forest cottage holiday. Our eclectic collection of houses provide very special retreats. These are quirky homes that are set up for tranquillity, family adventures and big celebrations. We have plenty of unexpected ideas to make your stay memorable – some lavish, some challenging, some for the price of a packet of marshmallows… For 9 years we have been offering New Forest cottages and holiday houses. Big, small, luxury, eccentric, seaside and forest… We offer stays from 2 nights to 2 weeks or longer stays up to 6 months. We’ve gone from 1 house in 2011 to nearly 20 now. We are proud of the care we take of people. Our experience and knowledge of the area and the houses is excellent. We love to share the best local spots and help people make happy memories.

title: Highdale B & B Bed and Breakfast in Nailsea
subtitle: Highdale B&B offers quality bed and breakfast in comfortable and homely surroundings.
bodyContent: Highdale B&B offers quality bed and breakfast in comfortable and homely surroundings. Located in the charming town of Nailsea, Highdale is conveniently located for business travellers with easy access to the M5, Bristol city centre and Bristol Airport. Nailsea supports a number of traditional pubs and restaurants offering a choice ranging from fine dining through to convenient takeaways. Located in picturesque North Somerset, Nailsea sits between Weston-Super-Mare and Bristol City with easy access to many local attractions such as Wells, the Mendips AONB, the North Somerset Levels, Tintsfield House and Noah’s Ark Zoo. A perfect base for a relaxing few days away.

title: Number 14 York Street
subtitle: Number 14 York Street is a fashionable former city centre merchants house, now owned by an artist.
bodyContent: Number 14 York Street is a fashionable city centre former merchants house, now owned by an artist. It is superbly situated in the very heart of historic Bath! Bath’s most significant tourist attractions – the Roman Baths, the Bath Abbey, the Thermae Spa – are all within 200m.The train and bus stations are 4/5 minutes walk. Car parking is available. Please see our website www.yorkstreetbath.co.uk The house has been renovated to the highest standards and stylishly combines period detail with contemporary fittings. The luxurious 4* accommodation is arranged over 3 floors. You will find plenty of space to sleep 4 adults in two bedroom suites (one with king bed and adjoining luxury bathroom -the other with twin beds and adjoining luxury monsoon shower room) . Each room has a flat screen TV/DVD . As you would expect there is an ultra-modern kitchen with dishwasher, freezer and washing machine. You will find a comfortable living/dining room. Internet (wifi) access is provided. Original art works hang in every room. If you are looking for an eclectic mix of a grade 2 listed dwelling combined with every modern facility right in the centre of Bath then this is the place for you!
tagline: Number 14 York Street is a fashionable former city centre merchants house

title: Retro Electro & Enjoy The Silence
subtitle: Purple Rose Promotions Presents an 80's Synth Pop Co-Headline!
bodyContent: Retro Electro are an established 5-piece synth-pop tribute to the 1980s recreating the music of that iconic decade. Playing regularly since 2012 the band have a large following and play to sell out audiences across the UK. Gigs have included support slots with Dodgy, the Christians and the Blow Monkeys as well as being on the same bill as Tony Hadley, China Crisis and Clare Grogan. If you want to hear your favourite songs from the decade, in a live high energy show, recreated by musicians who love the music as much as you did, Retro Electro are for you! Think Human League, Duran Duran, Pet Shop Boys, Thompson Twins, Spandau Ballet, Erasure, OMD, Bowie, Prince, Simple Minds and many more. Come to the party, sing and dance and salute the 80s! Enjoy the Silence UK aim to replicate the classic-era DEPECHE MODE live experience, delivering the hit singles and album tracks/rarities. The band has a strong visual appeal with live and electronic percussion, guitar, three-part vocals and synchronised background digital graphics. ETS UK have established themselves a formidable live reputation, playing at the prestigious ISLE OF WIGHT FESTIVAL in 2025, three years running on the FAKE FESTIVAL circuit, supporting the legendary HEAVEN 17 at a Butlins 80s Weekender and entertaining venues up and down the country from Bristol to Edinburgh.

title: New House Farm (West Country Parks)
subtitle: New House Farm in Walrow is located within a 5-minute drive of the coastal resort of Burnham-on-Sea with miles of golden sandy beaches, shops and amusement activities to enjoy. All facilities are located on the ground floor and each cottage consists of a multi-purpose living room/breakfast area/kitchen, 1-2 bedrooms and a family bathroom;
bodyContent: Located on the fringes of the Somerset Levels , New House Farm is home to 26 l uxury timber holiday lodges and is the ideal holiday park for visitors who want to explore the great outdoors and enjoy country walks whilst experiencing easy access to the entire South West . The seaside town of Burnham-on-Sea is just a short drive from the park, with miles of golden sandy beaches, shops and amusement activities to enjoy. All facilities are located on the ground floor and each cottage consists of a multi-purpose living room/breakfast area/kitchen, 1-2 bedrooms and a family bathroom; Our selection of self-catering holiday cottages offers options to suit parties of 2-4. Kingfisher Cottage sleeps two, boasting a four-poster bedroom with en-suite. Woodpecker Cottage sleeps 3 (one double and one single). Kestrel Cottage sleeps four (one double and one twin). Each cottage is fully equipped with all the necessities that you will need to enjoy your stay with us including gas central heating, digital TV, electric cooker, microwave, cooking utensils, towels, bed linen, hairdryer and an iron and ironing board. Guests also have access to private parking, a shared laundry with coin operated washer/dryers and a shared grass courtyard with outdoor seating area – the perfect place to relax with a glass of wine.
tagline: New House Farm in Walrow is located within a 5-minute drive of the coastal resort of Burnham-on-Sea

title: Mr Darcy’s Residence
subtitle: Mr Darcy’s Residence is a listed, Georgian townhouse with bags of historical charm.
bodyContent: Mr Darcy’s Abode is a beautiful historic townhouse that oozes chic, Georgian style. Seven wonderful bedrooms, featuring super king size beds that can be unzipped to single beds. There are also extra single beds and a few sets of full sized bunk beds for extra guests. There is a large drawing room with the latest audio/visual to relax, a hand built bespoke fitted kitchen with top of the range appliances and a large dining table. Ample bathroom space for larger groups including luxury walk-in showers and a period bathtub. 2 night min stay at weekends (Fri-Sun) and a min 16 guest rate at weekends & Christmas (if less than 16 staying, the 16 person price will still apply)
tagline: Mr Darcy’s Residence is a listed, Georgian townhouse with bags of historical charm.

title: Hill House
subtitle: Escape the busy routines of life and Relax at Hill House with a bit of “home from home ”me time”.
bodyContent: Welcome To Guest Accommodation Hill House Bath Escape the busy routines of life and Relax at Hill House with a bit of “home from home ”me time”. Whether it’s history and heritage , the amazing array of independent shops restaurants, its art and culture or just the scenery and friendly social vibe, the central location of Hill House (yet only 15 minutes from country walks) makes it an ideal location to Explore Bath and the South West. If you need any further information Harry, Douglas and the team are always there to assist. All you have to do is ask. Hill House is a four storey Georgian Town House, built in 1762, which, being situated in the heart of historic Bath between the 3 Crescents – The Royal Crescent, Lansdown Crescent and Camden Crescent- is a great base to Experience all that Bath has to offer. Refurbished in 2011 its six individually decorated en suite rooms retain much of their original charm and character with all the amenities expected by a traveller in the 21st century including original artwork throughout.
tagline: Escape the busy routines of life and Relax at Hill House

title: Michelle Wolf: Best Job in the World
subtitle: Primetime Emmy Nominee Michelle Wolf has established herself as one of the most influential voices in the comedy landscape.
bodyContent: Primetime Emmy Nominee Michelle Wolf has established herself as one of the most influential voices in the comedy landscape. Her stand-up specials across HBO and Netflix have garnered critical acclaim and top viewing figures. Wolf has headlined across the world, including her infamous appearance at the White House Correspondents Dinner. She has had two sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs and scored a prestigious Edinburgh Comedy Award nomination. title: The Bird, Bath
subtitle: A vibrant, independently-owned boutique hotel with the best views across Bath
bodyContent: A vibrant, independently-owned boutique hotel with the best views across Bath To be found just a few minutes' stroll from Bath's spectacular city-centre attractions, The Bird, Bath (previously The County Hotel) is the city’s newest boutique hotel where visitors to Bath migrate. Owned by seasoned hoteliers, Ian and Christa Taylor, The Bird features 31 thoughtfully-designed rooms from spacious family rooms to light-filled double or twin rooms – many with views out over Bath Abbey and The Rec – to compact but well-furnished cosy rooms at the top of the house. Beautiful pieces of art, Nespresso coffee machines and the comfiest beds combine to create the perfect home from home. Delicious cooked-to-order and continental breakfasts are served in The Roost at the heart of The Bird, while there are also vibrant meeting and event spaces perfect for workshops, get-togethers, private parties, celebrations and more. With restful public areas and some of the coolest party space in town, The Bird is easily reached via all main approaches to Bath, and has plenty of parking for guests.

title: No 1 Park Terrace
subtitle: Stay at No 1 Park Terrace, a Victorian town house close to the town centre in the ancient market town of Glastonbury.
bodyContent: We can accommodate up to 9 people in 5 beautiful bedrooms. Our prices reflect the number of people staying so we are very happy to have groups of guests from 4 - 9 people, the choice is yours!

title: Honeysuckle Farm Cottages
subtitle: 3 Luxury Sustainable Cottages for your holiday break in Glastonbury
bodyContent: Get away from it all in the fascinating town of Glastonbury. Situated on the ‘light side’ of Glastonbury Tor, Honeysuckle Farm Cottages forms a wonderful sun-trap, perfectly balancing the peace and tranquility of a rural get away, with the vibrancy of Glastonbury’s unique town centre. We have 3 luxury, self-sustainable, self-catering cottages which sleep between 4 and 8 people each. Our ethos is to provide a really enjoyable, environmentally responsible and practical self-catering holiday destination. Once here, you won’t need your vehicle – there’s so much to see and do all within walking or cycling distance – we even provide the bicycles! Steeped in history, with excellent facilities, friendly people, beautiful surroundings and some amazing local attractions you’re sure to have a fantastically inspiring time.

title: Moncrate Cottage
subtitle: Superbly located cottage 2 miles from Bradford on Avon and 5 miles from Bath.
bodyContent: Superbly located cottage 2 miles from Bradford on Avon and 5 miles from Bath. The recently refurbished Moncrate Cottage gives the perfect home-from-home feel that everyone wants on holiday. Comfortable and cosy accommodation for a family getaway in wonderful rural surroundings. A well-equipped property with everything you should need. The Indoor heated pool and Games Room provides endless entertainment for the whole family.

title: The Choral Pilgrimage 2026: Wells
subtitle: A programme exploring majestic music from the Spanish Renaissance alongside spellbinding works from James MacMillan and Kerensa Briggs.
bodyContent: Spain’s Siglo de Oro, the Age of Gold, gave rise to some of the greatest sacred choral music of the Renaissance. The range of emotion covered by composers in the Spanish Renaissance is demonstrated beautifully in the selected works by Cristóbal de Morales and Sebastián de Vivanco that form the basis of this year's Choral Pilgrimage: Lead, Kindly Light. These works are complemented by settings of words by two poems from Saint John Henry Newman: Sir James MacMillan’s Nothing in Vain, and the world premiere of Kerensa Briggs’ Lead, Kindly Light, specially commissioned for the Choral Pilgrimage.

title: Dunster Castle Outdoor Theatre: King Arthur & The Holy Fail
subtitle: The Three Inch Fools present an epic tale of Arthurian adventure and medieval mayhem.
bodyContent: In a land of daring quests, dashing knights, and endless jousting, there lived a would-be hero - waiting in the wings - who went by the name of Arthur. But when Camelot is rocked to its core by a tragic - and frankly improbable - incident involving a large table of an undisclosed shape, Arthur is thrust into the quest of a lifetime. Will he bravely battle through blistering cold and scorching fire to save his beloved realm, or will he crumble as fate refuses to cooperate? Destiny awaits, chivalry calls, and the quest to end all quests begins. Saddle up - things are about to get legendary. Saturday 15th August, 18:30-20:30. title: The Castle at Taunton
subtitle: The Castle Hotel is in the centre of Taunton the old County town for Somerset. It is the gateway to the Black Downs and Exmoor National Park, West Somerset Railway, being 5 minute drive from the main line train station from London Paddington, whilst being 30 minutes from the M5 Junction 25 and close many amenities.
bodyContent: The Castle at Taunton is one of the UK’s most historic & prestigious 4 Star Hotels, having been at the forefront of British cuisine for 40 years. We also operate Brazz, which since 1998 has provided the blueprint for British Brasseries across the country The Castle Hotel is a unique family-owned hotel set in a historic building in the heart of Taunton in Somerset. A simple ethos lies at the heart of the hotel – to offer the warmest of welcomes, give the utmost personal attention and exemplary service to each & every guest. The Castle Hotel is a one-off, not a link in a chain. The Castle’s reputation for fine food and wine, comfort, and attentive service has been built by three generations of the Chapman Family, with a passion for promoting the highest standards in every aspect of the hotel. Taunton lies at the heart of the region, making The Castle the ideal base from which to explore the history, magic and wonder of the West Country. Each of The Castle’s 44 bedrooms are individually decorated, offering its own personality and comfort away from home. Whether you’re looking for healthy or hearty, you’ll find it all at the award-winning restaurant, Brazz. Featuring a wide-ranging menu, you’ll find favourites such as Brazz Fishcakes – which have been present since day one – as well as Quantock Lamb, Brixham Crab and much more. The Castle’s legendary afternoon teas are served Wednesday to Sunday from 2:30pm - 4:00pm. Freshly baked scones with West Country clotted cream and strawberry jam, elegant finger sandwiches, pastries and cakes along with a fine selection of loose-leaf tea, make this a very special occasion… especially if you add a bottle of champagne.
tagline: A unique family-owned hotel set in a historic building in Taunton, the county town of Somerset

bodyContent: Tea and coffee making facilities and flatscreen TVs with DVD players. Our comfortable beds all have snuggly duvets and pillows, cotton sheets and pretty soft furnishings, and you will find a hospitalities tray in your room. If you have any special requests please let us know, we will be happy to help.

title: North Down Farm
subtitle: Brand new for 2023! The Cabin at North Down Farm is an idyllic retreat that is as stunning on the inside as it is on the outside. With outstanding views from your own decking this cool cabin for two is the ideal spot for an escape to the country.
bodyContent: Step inside and you'll discover luxury interiors inspired by the colours of the Somerset countryside, cosy wood burner, sumptuous sofa and gorgeous wrought iron king-size bed. This welcoming cabin is a lovely space with, comfy green velvet sofa, countryside views and a Smart TV, there's also a Roberts digital radio with Bluetooth. For non-electrical entertainment, there's some good old-fashioned board games, playing cards and a number of books. The fully functioning kitchen with beautiful wooden worktop and hand made taps includes an Everhot stove, providing not only heating but multi tasking as an oven. Sleeping two, there is a king-size wrought iron bed with luxury British made pocket sprung mattress filled with all natural fibers and White Company linens, cloud soft bedding and stylish cushions. Outside you have full use of your own decking with the most stunning views down a private valley to the Quantock hills in the distance, the perfect spot for a morning coffee or evening drinks. Set on the edge of Exmoor just outside of Wiveliscombe this is the perfect location for a wonderful escape. A huge draw for walkers and cyclists Exmoor and the Quantocks are in easy reach and the North Somerset coast just 25 minutes away. Set on the edge of the designated 'Dark Skies Area' The Cabin is the perfect place to star gaze as an expert astronomer or just appreciate the spectacular night sky. We welcome all our guests with a basket filled with local produce.

title: Midford Mill
subtitle: A Grade II Listed Mill House situated in a country location on the southern outskirts of Bath.
bodyContent: The ground floor living area provides an extremely comfortable and functional space for 10 people. Entertainment is provided by two 50″ HDTVs, with a fantastic woodburner to the main reception room. Comfortable sofas and armchairs provide relaxing seating. For meal times there is a large wooden table in the dining room together with a cosy ‘lookout’ seating area that overlooks the mill weir. There is a fully equipped kitchen with AGA, additional induction hob, dishwasher, fridge-freezer, microwave, toaster, coffee machine and kettle. The space is also practical with plenty of coat hooks and a boot rack, waste bin and recycling containers in the utility area. Upstairs there are very comfortable Vi-Spring beds with crisp white cotton bedding and fluffy towels are provided. There are 4 very large bedrooms that all have beautiful views over the river and countryside beyond. On the first floor there is a a family bathroom, and two bedrooms: one bedroom has a Kingsize bed and the second bedroom has a king and single bed. On the second floor there is the master bedroom with Superking bed and the second bedroom has a double and single bed. The rooms are connected by a very large landing where a small sofa and light have been placed, which is great space for those looking for a quiet place to chill out. All rooms have a minimalist feel and are finished with hand-made linen roman blinds. Bathroom, Shower-room and facilities: The mid-floor bathroom is very large with the usual toilet, washbasin and large free-standing teardrop bath. Downstairs there is a modern wet-room with large shower area. For convenience a washing machine, separate tumble dryer, iron, ironing board, travel cot and hairdryer are provided. Externally: There is a fantastic (120 m2) patio in-between the mill-house and the river and over 3/4 acre of gardens that include river fishing rights, an island and a large lawn. For more information or to enquire about your preferred dates, please contact us today . Please use code MB19-10OFF at the Availability Page to gain a 10% discount.

title: Mendip Mini Fests at Mendip Basecamp | 31st July to 2nd August
subtitle: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends!
bodyContent: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests. These will be relaxed, family-friendly festivals, without the big ticket prices, exclusively for campers, across six weekends! Set in an award-winning adventure campsite in the Mendip Hills, Somerset, guests can enjoy off-grid camping, campfires, and woodland adventures. At the on-site Mendip Activity Centre, guests also have access to more than 20 outdoor adventures, from snowsports and archery to frisbee golf and watersports. Across the weekends, Basecamp will offer outdoor workshops, circus skills, children’s storytelling, live acoustic music, and Sunday morning yoga, with Saturday nights bringing the Bandwagon stage to life with headline local bands. On Friday 31st July South West-based Sam Evans will bring uplifting soul, folk, and pop sounds for a warm, feel-good performance. No stranger to the stage, Sam has over 1,000 live performances to his name, and has played on the BBC Introducing set at Glastonbury. On Saturday 1st August, Aardvarks, formerly known as Razzomo, will take over with their high-energy world-folk fusion performance, delivering a lively headline set guaranteed to get the crowd moving. Dream of playing a festival stage? Now you can! For the chance to perform a 30-minute opening set, enter Basecamp's Mendip Mini Fest competition. Simply complete the online form, and upload your performance video to apply.
tagline: This summer, Mendip Basecamp is launching Mendip Mini Fests.

subtitle: elcome to Nyland Manor and The Stables, our family-owned and run self-catering holiday cottage.
bodyContent: We are situated on the outskirts of the world- famous village of Cheddar in Somerset, making our location perfect for exploring the UK's largest gorge, Glastonbury Tor or the rolling Mendip Hills. We are passionate about creating a home away from home experience, and like to think that we really have thought of everything to make your time with us very special. We hope to welcome you to Nyland Manor in the near future.

title: Kingsdon Inn
subtitle: The Kingsdon Inn is a beautiful 300 year old thatched pub, located in the small village Kingsdon in Somerset.
bodyContent: The pub used to be a Cider House many years ago, no doubt serving the locals with its own cider brew. Today the pub is hosted by Adam and Cinzia who have a wealth of experience in some of the UK's most respected hotels and restaurants. They have made food a key part of the Kingsdon's appeal. Making use of seasonal, local and often organic produce. Bed and breakfast with cosy, comfortable rooms ensuring a refreshing and luxurious stay. The three bedrooms all have en-suite and have new cottage style decor, with home from home comforts. We are proud of our pub and dining room serving revamped old English comfort food to light southern Italian influenced dishes. So our guests are able to enjoy food and drink with us too. Bookings include Full English Breakfast. Please do bear in mind that the premise is closed between 3 pm-6 pm so unfortunately we can not offer check-ins at these times. You are more than welcome to check in between 12 pm - 3 pm and after 6 pm

title: Mendip Magic
subtitle: Mendip Magic is a fine two bedroom cottage, furnished to a high standard and well equipped in every way.
bodyContent: Mendip Magic is a well furnished and fully equipped holiday cottage set in peaceful rural surroundings close to Bath, Bristol & Wells. Because the cottage is double glazed, has full oil fired central heating and a log fireplace it is cosy and ideal for winter breaks. The cottage has two bedrooms (1 Double and 1 Twin Single) which sleeps four people. The cottage is Mobility 1 Graded. It has ground floor level ramped access with no steps There are 2 steps internally between the kitchen area and the dining room. Free facilities include Boules Court, HotTub, Sauna, Fitness Centre and Barbecue Hut, plus Video/DVD Library. There is a private patio with garden furniture, ample, safe parking next to the cottage. Pets are accepted by prior arrangement only. Booking Mendip Magic Fully flexible short breaks are available all year round. title: One Night In Nashville
subtitle: One Night In Nashville is the UK's #1 and only true Downtown-Nashville & Honky Tonk Experience.
bodyContent: One Night In Nashville is the UK's #1 and only true Downtown-Nashville & Honky Tonk Experience. Inspired by today’s Nashville music scene, and recreating the buzzing atmosphere of Honky Tonks and songwriter rounds, One Night In Nashville offer their audience a true, authentic slice of the Nashville Experience here in the UK, featuring the biggest Country Hits. Following a song writing trip and tour in Nashville herself, UK Country/Americana Artist Maria Jordan wanted to bring the magic and soul of Nashville & the music that inspired her songs to UK audiences. Transporting the audience right to the heart of Nashville today, the show features a 90 minute performance led by Maria Jordan and her incredible band. Giving the crowd a true to life experience of a Honky Tonk music venue, the band is made up of some of the finest multi-instrumentalists, established songwriters, musicians, producers and performers in the UK Country/Americana scene. The vision of this show is to give music lovers “One Night In Nashville”!

title: History Alive: Bowlore Medieval at The Bishop's Palace
subtitle: Step back in time this August bank holiday as Bowlore take over The Bishop’s Palace for a weekend of immersive living history.
bodyContent: Across the historical Palace grounds, visitors can explore a bustling encampment and experience what life may have been like in medieval England. From domestic crafts and camp cooking to military drills and skirmishes, this family-friendly event brings history vividly to life through sight, sound and atmosphere. The weekend will be led by Bowlore, an experienced group of historical re-enactors dedicated to recreating everyday medieval life. Throughout the weekend, Bowlore will be fully in character, sharing the skills, stories and routines of the period and giving visitors the chance to see history unfolding around them. Alongside the re-enactment weekend, visitors can also enjoy: - The medieval Palace buildings and Undercroft - 14 acres of RHS partner gardens - Family-friendly multimedia tours and digital guides - The Dragon’s Lair play area - Refreshments at the award-winning Bishop’s Table café Image credit: Matt Turner
tagline: Step back in time this August bank holiday as Bowlore take over The Bishop’s Palace

subtitle: Stay at the magnificent Edgar Townhouse hotel. Designated as a Grade I listed building and in a UNESCO World Heritage Site, The Edgar is on Great Pulteney Street located in Central Bath close to all the major attractions, shops and restaurants.
bodyContent: Stay at the magnificent Edgar Townhouse hotel. Designated as a Grade I listed building and in a UNESCO World Heritage Site, The Edgar is on Great Pulteney Street located in Central Bath close to all the major attractions, shops and restaurants. Friendly staff welcome you to our family run bed and breakfast. All rooms are centrally heated and are a mixture of double, twin, single and family rooms, all having their own private shower and WC, colour TV, tea and coffee making facilities. The room rate includes our generous breakfast which has many options from the traditional full English to smoked salmon. Rooms vary in size from our newly decorated to our small 5th floor doubles. We are located 5 minutes walk to the Roman Bath and Abbey and all other major attractions, shops and restaurants. 15 minutes walk from the train station or 5 minutes in a taxi. On street parking available for a one off charge for your entire stay. Please contact us for details. For further information on tours from Bath please contact us. title: Park Farm Country Cottages
subtitle: Park Farm Country Cottages are perfectly located for those who value the peace and tranquility of the countryside and yet wish to explore the many attractions that Bristol, Bath, Wells and the surrounding area have to offer.
bodyContent: Park Farm Country Cottages are perfectly located for those who value the peace and tranquility of the countryside and yet wish to explore the many attractions that Bristol, Bath , Wells and the surrounding area have to offer. Within 30 minute walk of the cottages is the ancient stone circle and toll house at Stanton Drew and Maes Knoll Tump an iron age hill-fort from which there are panoramic views of Bristol, The Severn Bridge/Estuary as well as the Chew Valley with it's lakes! Maes Knoll Tump is part of the 3 Peaks Circular Walk, (Forest of Avon) the Community Forest Path also passes through the farm, as well as the National Cycle Route 3. The village of Chew Magna (5 min drive, 25 min walk) is our very attractive local centre, and has an interesting history. It was once a thriving woollen centre, it has raised pavements and many listed buildings, from pretty cottages to large Georgian houses and medieval buildings. Chew Magna has 3 pubs all serving good food, a good village food store, a traditional butcher, a bank, a post office/gift shop and a cafe/gift shop, and is an excellent place to wander and explore. Chew Valley Lake (2.5 miles) along with it's sister lakes are very popular with anglers and birdwatchers, with over 260 types of birds have been recorded there, the restaurant and picnic facilities at Chew Valley and Blagdon Lakes provide a lovely setting for refreshment perhaps followed by a walk along a waterside trail. Other local attractions include: Roman Baths Wells Cathedral SS Great Britain Clifton Suspension Bridge Longleat Choose from two cottages: The Dairy or The Barn.

title: An Evening with Big Big Train at Komedia Bath
subtitle: Big Big Train are delighted to make their debut in Bath at The Komedia in September 2026.
bodyContent: The Woodcut & Other Stories 2026 Tour Big Big Train are delighted to make their debut in Bath at The Komedia in September 2026. Big Big Train will be promoting their recently announced studio album Woodcut, which will be released on 6th February 2026 by the renowned InsideOut/Sony label. As the band’s first ever full-length conceptual piece, Woodcut explores creativity, sacrifice and the thin line between inspiration and madness. During this two hour plus show, the band will be focussing significantly on Woodcut, as well as playing some fan favourites from their back catalogue plus other early material which has not been performed for over 25 years.Since the recruitment of lead vocalist Alberto Bravin in 2022, the award-winning progressive rock band have played almost 60 shows in the UK, Germany, The Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Switzerland, Italy, Portugal, the USA and Canada as well as co-headlining the prestigious Cruise To The Edge and appearing at various UK and European festivals. Alongside Bravin and founder member Gregory Spawton, the band features an impressive list of musicians, namely drummer Nick D’Virgilio, guitarist/keyboardist Rikard Sjöblom, violinist Clare Lindley, keyboardist Oskar Holldorff and trumpet player Paul Mitchell. Their combined experience includes playing with bands such as Genesis, Steve Hackett, PFM, Tears For Fears, Mr Big, Spock’s Beard, Beardfish, Stackridge and Dim Gray, among others.

title: The George Hotel
subtitle: The George Hotel is a newly refurbished hotel, restaurant and bar, ideally situated in the heart of the bustling market town of Crewkerne.
bodyContent: The George Hotel is a newly refurbished hotel, restaurant and bar, ideally situated in the heart of the bustling market town of Crewkerne . The George has been providing travellers with a warm welcome, comfortable bed, good value for money and excellent service for over 400 years. We now feature individually designed twin, double and double deluxe rooms as well as a luxurious family room all fitted with the best modern amenities, including en-suite bathrooms, flatscreen televisions, free Wi-fi, hairdryers and tea & coffee making facilities. A free full English or continental breakfast is available every morning. The restaurant welcomes all comers from breakfast through to morning coffee and cake, lunch and dinner. It offers the best in classic British cuisine with a number of tantalising twists. Our chef’s home cooked meals, including mouth-watering sweets, are made with local produce where ever possible. The bar provides the perfect place to relax with a fine wine, local beer or perhaps a cocktail, both popular favourites and new ideas. The George remains as it has for generations past, a haven for the traveller and a focal point for the surrounding community. Visit the striking 15th-century church or wander around the town’s tearooms and art, antique and book shops or the Heritage Centre. Crewkerne is ideally situated for exploring the south coast and the Somerset countryside. A special corporate rate is available so please contact us for further details. For further information on our facilities, offers and upcoming events please go to our website www.southcoastinns.com , alternatively we would be glad to discuss any requirements that you may have and will endeavour to accommodate your needs.

title: The Smiths Ltd + Transmission
subtitle: The Smiths Ltd was formed in Manchester, UK the hometown of The Smiths.
bodyContent: The Smiths Ltd was formed in Manchester, UK the hometown of The Smiths. After an extensive search to find the perfect Morrissey, the band played their first gig in Manchester to an audience of avid Smiths fans. The response was spectacular and The Smiths Ltd now play at venues and festivals all over the UK. If you never saw The Smiths then this is your chance to experience the thrill of those great songs played live. If you were lucky enough to see them first time around then prepare to relive that excitement again. Committed to getting the same energy that Morrissey, Johnny Marr, Andy Rourke and Mike Joyce had onstage together, the band are obsessed about getting that live sound right. With an authenticity and provenance that’s hard to beat The Smiths Ltd are the ultimate tribute.
tagline: The Smiths Ltd was formed in Manchester, UK the hometown of The Smiths.

customFields:
[{"key":"NewsID","value":"551"},{"key":"NewsBody","value":"The winners of the 2025 Bristol, Bath, Somerset and Gloucestershire tourism awards have been announced at a gala dinner at the Apex City of Bath Hotel.
 
These annual awards recognise and celebrate the finest of the area’s hospitality and visitor economy businesses at a time when the sector is continuing to face economic pressure.
 
Giles Adams, Chair of Visit Somerset said, “I am delighted to see so many winners from Somerset this year, which underlines the local commitment to top customer service, value and experience. Nearly every category has been won by a Somerset business which is a great tribute to all the hard work throughout our world-class county.”
 
“Noah’s Ark Zoo Farm consistently feature highly in these awards and are a superb example of innovation. Along with many other winners including Wall Eden Farm, Wells Cathedral, Glastonbury Abbey, Shepton Mallet Prison, Walnut Barn Estate, Riverside Holiday Village and The Swan Hotel in Wells it’s a brilliant role call for our sector. Our coast is also recognised with Sandy Glade Holiday Park and Warren Farm at Brean and Myrtle Cottage at Porlock.
 
Full details at www.somersettourismawards.org.uk

subtitle: Set on a working farm in the heart of beautiful Somerset countryside, Pear Tree Cottages offer luxury self-catering accommodation. 2 self catering cottages near Cheddar, Wells, Glastonbury & Bath.
bodyContent: Set on a working farm in the heart of beautiful Somerset countryside, Pear Tree Cottages offer luxury self-catering accommodation. The two cottages combine the traditional with every modern convenience. Both dwellings are spacious and beautifully light and airy, with private south-facing patio areas with table and chairs allowing you to soak up the Somerset sunshine. Enjoy walking or cycling over the Mendip Hills or across the billiard flat Somerset Levels or use the cottages as a base for exploring attractions such as Cheddar , Wells , Bath , Glastonbury and Weston-super-Mare . The farm is criss-crossed by footpaths and offers great views across the valley floor to Axbridge, Cheddar and Wells and even to Brean Down and the Bristol Channel beyond. The 4 star, gold award cottages are alongside a quiet country lane. The ancient settlement of Wedmore is 1.5 miles away and is known to historians as the place where Alfred the Great and the Viking king, Guthrum, agreed a peace treaty in 878 AD, and it is where Guthrum converted to Christianity. It’s also known to the modern visitor as a charming, bustling place alive with every amenity, whose busy shopping streets belie its size as a small village. You will find bijou designer clothing shops alongside shops selling the best local foodstuffs: a butchers/farm shop, a fishmonger, a delicatessen and a newsagent/off-licence. There are also three traditional Somerset pubs to eat and drink in. Cherry Plum Cottage. Cherry Plum Cottage sleeps two. The bedroom has a 5ft double bed with en-suite shower room. Luxurious bath sheets, combination feather duvets and rich cotton bed linen are provided in both cottages. The living room features leather sofas, an oak dining table and chairs and a stone fireplace with cosy woodburner. A basket of wood is included. There is a freeview TV, a DVD and a CD/radio/cassette player. WIFI broadband internet connection is also included. The well-equipped kitchen features a modern oven with ceramic hob, a dish-washer, fridge-freezer, microwave oven, washing machine and all the utensils you'll need. All rooms have underfloor heating. Cider Apple Cottage . Cider Apple Cottage has two bedrooms. Bedroom one has a 6ft zip and link double bed which can be unzipped to make two single beds. There is an adjoining bathroom with a shower over the bath. Bedroom two has a 5ft double bed with an en suite shower room. It also has a fold up Jay-be bed for an extra person if required. The bedrooms are at either end of the cottage with the living space between them. This is an ideal layout for friends and families who travel together. The living area and kitchen have the same facilities as Cherry Plum Cottage. There is ample parking outside and access to the adjacent secure shed where you can store your bicycles or golf clubs. This also holds a barbecue for your use. The cottages are on one level with a ramp from the parking area making wheel chair access easy. We also have a cot, highchair, baby bath and other useful items for babies.
tagline: Set on a working farm in the heart of beautiful Somerset countryside.
