title: Little Paradise
subtitle: Little Paradise is an attractive detached 2 bedroom cottage accommodating four persons.
bodyContent: Little Paradise is a spacious and fully equipped holiday cottage set in peaceful rural surroundings close to Bath, Bristol & Wells. Because the cottage is double glazed, has full oil fired central heating and a log fireplace it is cosy and ideal for winter breaks. The cottage has two bedrooms (One Super-King and One Twin Single) and accommodates four persons. The cottage is Mobility 1 Graded. It has 3 steps with hand rail for access. It is on ground floor level and has no internal steps or stairs. Old Dairy has a private enclosed garden with furniture and a rotary washing line. The cottage has adjacent safe parking. customFields:
[{"key":"NewsID","value":"550"},{"key":"NewsBody","value":"The Somerset Gardens Group was re-established this week at Kilver Court, very kindly hosted by Leta Showering and Heather Christian.

This group was previously facilitated by the tourism team at South Somerset District Council and sadly with the formation of a Unitary Council this resource was discontinued.

Visit Somerset is exceptionally keen for the gardens of Somerset to maintain and grow their excellent work. The portfolio across the county is an important feature for locals and visitors. Working together will yield many benefits - valuable knowledge exchange between partners and working collectively to build profile.

Attendees included Alice Kennard from Forde Abbey, Lindsay Mann from The Bishop's Palace and new owners of East Lambrook Manor Garden, Andrew and Alison Johnson. Other partners going forward are Hestercombe Gardens and the National Trust.

Other gardens are invited to join the group, please email giles.adams@visitsomerset.co.uk

title: Pembroke Cottage
subtitle: A detached self catering cottage in Somerset in Exmoor National Park, sleeps 5. Peaceful scenic setting, private garden and parking. Splendid south-westerly views.
bodyContent: A detached cottage in the heart of the Exmoor National Park , sleeping 5 in 3 bedrooms. See website for more images. Peaceful scenic setting, private garden and ample parking. Splendid south-westerly views of rolling Exmoor countryside, the perfect relaxing get away cottage. Sitting in unspoilt countryside on our family working farm, Pembroke is an excellent central base to explore all of Exmoor and West Somerset and yet only 5 minutes walk from Wheddon Cross. Awarded a 3 Star Gold Award in June 16, this is a peaceful, detached, well-equipped cottage on a working farm (but away from farmyard), with an open fire for the winter, private garden and amazing views. A perfect base for families, couples and walkers. Sorry, no pets.

title: The Oakhouse Hotel
subtitle: The Oakhouse Hotel, situated in the market square of the historic Somerset Town of Axbridge. With its original features, oak beams and snug fireplace the 17th century building creates a memorable setting for any family occasion.
bodyContent: The Oakhouse Hotel, situated in the market square of the historic Somerset Town of Axbridge. With its original features, oak beams and snug fireplace the 17th century building creates a memorable setting for any family occasion. The elegant dining room featuring our historic Well provides a private area for functions including Weddings, Christenings, and Anniversary and Birthday gatherings. We have 10 beautifully appointed en suite bedrooms, allowing guests to hold a private function and occupy the whole of the restaurant, bar and lounge areas to suit your requirements. Our two rosette restaurant is credit to our head chef Jacob Piggott and his team, alongside General Manager Simon Dodd. Parts of the Oak House date back to the 11th Century. Features include an ancient well and a large inglenook fire in the residents bar. Axbridge is a pretty town, lying at the foot of the Mendip Hills and looking out over the Somerset Levels. The town is blessed with a delightful Town Square, the focus of its narrow medieval streets. We have ten individually appointed en-suite rooms. Each of a slightly different, size, décor and comfort because that’s what our beautiful quirky listed building allows us. We have family rooms, junior suites, standard doubles , deluxe doubles and of course a bridal suite should you be staying with us for that special occasion. Rooms overlooking the square and our most popular, allowing you the ambience of the medieval town. Or we have quieter rooms if you prefer to be tucked away. Either way, the rooms each have an individual charm and our guests tell us that they “Love what we’ve done with the place” All rooms are equipped with flat screen TV, freshly ground coffee and Nespresso machines, freshly prepared shortbread biscuits and sumptuous robes, luxury toiletries and complimentary water. Each of our rooms are individual in design, comfortable and cozy, just like the rest of the hotel.
tagline: The Oakhouse Hotel, situated in the market square of the historic Somerset Town of Axbridge.

title: Kids Go Free & Eat Free at Shepton Mallet Prison This Summer*
subtitle: Looking for a family day out that’s anything but ordinary? Up to two children aged 5–15 go free with every paying adult at Shepton Mallet Prison until 1 September 2026 – plus kids can enjoy a free snack box with qualifying café purchases.*
bodyContent: Looking for a school-holiday day out that’s anything but ordinary? Take the family behind bars at Shepton Mallet Prison, where up to two children aged 5–15 receive free Prison Entry with every paying adult until 1 September 2026.* Children under five already visit free. Explore the World's Oldest Prison and one of Somerset's leading heritage attractions together, wander through historic prison wings, step inside original cells and uncover the fascinating stories of the prisoners and officers who once lived and worked behind these walls. It’s an immersive family adventure filled with history, discovery and plenty to talk about afterwards. Largely indoors, Shepton Mallet Prison is a great choice for rainy days, hot days and everything the British summer brings. Families can explore at their own pace, relax in the on-site café and even bring well-behaved dogs along. Kids can also enjoy a free children’s snack box with qualifying purchases in the prison café.* Want to make your visit even more memorable? Guided Tours and Escape Rooms can be added for an additional charge, subject to availability. Book your summer prison adventure now and select the Summer Family Offer ticket to claim your free child places. *Terms & Conditions apply. Kids Go Free on Prison Entry. Kids Eat Free: One free Children’s Snack Box for every £10 spent on food/drinks in our Café. See website for full T&Cs: https://www.sheptonmalletprison.com/events/family-days-out-somerset-summer-2026/

title: Liongate House
subtitle: 4 STAR GOLD AWARD BED AND BREAKFAST ACCOMMODATION in ILCHESTER near YEOVIL
bodyContent: Liongate House B&B is just 5 miles from the busy shopping centre of Yeovil and just over 5 miles from Haynes Motor Museum. RNAS Yeovilton and the Fleet Air Arm Museum with its many event days is just a 5 minute drive away. Convenient accommodation location for RNAS Yeovilton and Augusta Westland contracted workers. Liongate House is a sympathetically rebuilt barn situated in the historic Roman town of Ilchester. Completed in 2006 using the original bricks and roof tiles, the integrity of the outer building remains whilst the inside is designed in a more modern contemporary style. Energy efficient underfloor heating together with a heat recovery ventilation system and effective rainwater recycling serving all toilets make Liongate House an eco-friendly property to stay in. Our hearty breakfast includes local free-range eggs, home-baked bread, some organic produce and homemade marmalade and jams made with fruit from our garden. We are delighted to announce that we have achieved a AA Gold Star Award plus Breakfast Award for 2019 and a Certificate of Excellence 2018 from Trip Advisor which recognises our commitment to providing quality accommodation and an outstanding service for our guests.

title: The Royal Hotel Bath
subtitle: Designed by Brunel, visited by Queen Victoria, now lovingly restored and refurbished. Near bus and rail station, close to all attractions.
bodyContent: Designed by Brunel, visited by Queen Victoria, now lovingly restored and refurbished. Near bus and rail station, close to all attractions. Air-conditioned, non-smoking restaurant plus two air-conditioned bars. Excellent reputation for quality of food - specialising in grills, with a long established reputation for the 'best steaks in town'. All bedrooms are very comfortable, individually decorated and en-suite (2 with four poster beds). There are flat screen digital TV’s with Freeview and DVD players together with direct dial telephone and modem points in each room. The facilities include hairdryer, trouser press and a hospitality tray with tea and ground coffee making facilities together with complimentary biscuits and mineral water. In the four poster and superior rooms complimentary cotton slippers, the use of bathrobes and a personal safe for guests are also provided. A perfectly located, friendly hotel and an ideal base from which to enjoy our lovely city. There is a small meeting room (10 persons). Free WIFI.

title: Primrose Hill Holidays
subtitle: Self catering accommodation with private gardens and amazing sea and steam railway views.
bodyContent: Primrose Hill Holidays is situated between Exmoor National Park and the Quantock Hills and offers self-catering holiday in a peaceful and secluded environment but within easy reach of all that West Somerset has to offer. Within walking distance of picturesque Blue Anchor Bay with its sandy beach, pub and cafes and within the sight and sound of the West Somerset Railway . Easy access to Exmoor , the Quantock Hills and the South West Coast Path. Close to Dunster Castle . Fully wheelchair accessible. Well behaved dogs welcome. Ideally situated for walking, biking and sightseeing.....or just sitting and relaxing! The games room is equipped with pool table, table tennis and a good selection of books and games and plenty of beach toys. Enjoy a stroll on our woodland walk and you may see an owl or badger ! Short breaks available in March, April & October, call to discuss! We close from early January until mid March but still take bookings during this period. Ash Bungalow : Ash has 2 bedrooms. A room with a king sized bed and a twin room with an adjustable electric bed. The comfortable lounge and dining room both have wonderful views. Access to the private garden is from the lounge . The kitchen and bathroom are both spacious. Ash has a slope up to the front door so may not be suitable for all wheelchair users. There is additional access via the garden. Oak Bungalow : Oak has two bedrooms. A good sized king size bedroom and a smaller single room. The kitchen and bathroom are both spacious. Oak has a lovely large lounge with garden access and is a good choice if two families are on holiday together in adjacent bungalows as there is room for everyone to eat together. Oak is suitable for disabled guests Beech Bungalow : Beech has two bedrooms. The roomy twin with an adjustable electric bed. and a smaller bedroom with a double bed. The lounge is comfortable with access to the garden. The kitchen and bathroom are both spacious. Beech is suitable for disabled guests. Elm Bungalow : Elm has three bedrooms, one bedroom with a king size bed and two single bedrooms. The sunny patio and side access to the garden is from the lounge/ diner. Elm is popular with families as the bedrooms are off the hall making them quieter for little people to sleep in! Elm has level access and wide doors but the room layout makes it unsuitable for guests who use a wheelchair indoors. Short breaks available in March, April & October, call to discuss! We close from early January until mid March but still take bookings during this period.
tagline: Primrose Hill offers spacious, comfortable self-catering accommodation in Blue Anchor, Somerset.

title: Little England Retreats
subtitle: We are located in a rural setting at the end of a quiet no-through road.
bodyContent: This is the space if you want somewhere to rest, recuperate and recharge your batteries. It’s also a great place to use as a base if you want to explore the many and varied places of interest nearby. Whether your interests are history, walking, cycling, wildlife and especially birdwatching, this is the place to be. The village itself has a its own village bakery that sells amazing bread and cakes – and if you want to sit in and eat there is also a café area. Food is also served in the village pub, The London Inn. There is very little light pollution in the village, so on clear nights, the stars are out in abundance.

title: Hot Bath House
subtitle: Hot Bath House is a boutique styled, Georgian townhouse with the best address in the city! It provides contemporary, luxurious living and is right next door to the Thermae Bath Spa.
bodyContent: Hot Bath House is a boutique styled Georgian town house with the best address in the city! Contemporary luxurious living, right next door to the Thermae Bath Spa. Hot Bath House was a beautiful Georgian shop. This wonderful Georgian townhouse now provides ample space and comfort for our guests. Four spacious bedrooms sleeping 12 guests. There is a large sitting room to relax in and a beautiful open kitchen. Ample bathroom space for larger groups including double walk-in showers filled with Cowshed amenities and fluffy towels. 2 night min stay at weekends (Fri-Sun) and a min 10 guest rate at weekends & Christmas (if less than 10 staying, the 10 person price will still apply). PLEASE CONTACT US FOR PRICES & AVAILABILITY

title: Thought Control – A Tribute to Pink Floyd
subtitle: Thought Control are pleased to bring their Tribute to Pink Floyd back to the Komedia in Bath.
bodyContent: We present well over two hours of classic songs with an unforgettable spectacle of sound and light. On stage, we will carefully recreate all-time classics such as "Another Brick In The Wall", “Money”, "Comfortably Numb" and "Wish You Were Here", along with epics such as "Echoes" and "Shine On You Crazy Diamond". The lighting, projection and laser effects create the perfect backdrop, and have been further enhanced for 2026. Whether a die-hard fan or new to Pink Floyd, let Thought Control immerse you in the magic of one of the greatest bands of all time.

title: The Yarn Market Hotel
subtitle: Ideally located in the centre of the medieval village of Dunster. The hotel is two and half hours via the A39 from the M5 - but is ten minutes away from the West Somerset Railway England's longest heritage railway. With Minehead 20 minutes away there are all the major facilities you need.
bodyContent: The Yarn Market Hotel in Dunster is ideally located in the centre of Dunster, one of the most perfectly preserved medieval villages in England, and the gateway to Exmoor National Park. The magnificent Dunster Castle is at the end of the street and the West Somerset Railway runs close by. There are many themed breaks on offer throughout the year, and the area is perfect for those who enjoy outdoor activities or just a relaxing break. For walkers the hotel has excellent facilities including a boot and drying room, and maps are readily available combined with local knowledge to help you with your walks. Most of the bedrooms have either a view over the village or the surrounding countryside. Pets are most welcome at the hotel in the dog-friendly rooms. The restaurant opens daily for dinner, reservations are advisable.
tagline: Our Hotel is situated in the beautiful Village of Dunster, within the Exmoor National Park.

title: Purbeck Holiday Lets
subtitle: A refreshingly warm welcome awaits you at Purbeck Holiday Lets, a family run business offering luxurious self catering holiday accommodation close to the beautiful and historic Roman city of Bath in England.
bodyContent: A refreshingly warm welcome awaits you at Purbeck Holiday Lets, a family run business offering luxurious self catering holiday accommodation close to the beautiful and historic Roman city of Bath in England. Our self catering holiday accommodation in Somerset will exceed all of your expectations, so whether you are on business or a vacation, alone or taking a romantic break, with your family or with a group of friends and colleagues, you’ll have a great time and enjoy the freedom self catering holiday has to offer. Purbeck Holiday Lets luxurious self catering holiday accommodation comes in the form of two brand new Scandinavian lodges or log cabins and also two holiday apartments coming soon! The Luxurious self catering log cabins have 2 well equipped double bedrooms as well as a sofa bed and can sleep up to six people comfortably. The self catering holiday apartments will have one well equipped double room and can accommodate up to 2 people comfortably. Purbeck Holiday Lets is situated within the peaceful village of Camerton in Somerset, providing the perfect setting in which guests can relax and enjoy the tranquillity of the English countryside where there are some superb walks, pony trekking and cycling routes nearby. Camerton is a hamlet situated just 15 minutes from Bath, lying on the Cam Brook set in the heart of the Cam Valley. Built around the former branch line from the Bristol and North Somerset Railway which was used mainly to transport coal. The line's services were suspended in 1915, resumed in 1923 and finally withdrawn in 1925. The film Titfield Thunderbolt was filmed shortly after the railway line shut. The surrounding areas of Camerton in Somerset have so much to offer and within a short drive there are many varied attractions. These include the Roman city of Bath, with its wonderful restaurants and bars, fabulous shopping and street entertainers, historic Roman baths and Georgian Architecture. The ancient town of Glastonbury , which attracts so many thousands of visitors each year to the Glastonbury music festival and Longleat House and Safari Park owned by Lord Bath, one of the countries leading wildlife Parks. All of which makes Purbeck Holiday Lets the perfect base for exploring and enjoying the many varied local attractions available. Purbeck Holiday Lets welcome children, so for our younger guests both a travel cot and high chair can be provided on request. A Continental Breakfast can also be arranged for your convenience upon request. If you are celebrating a special occasion, let us arrange a few extra surprises for your loved one upon arrival, champagne, wine, a bouquet of flowers or chocolates. Whatever your needs, to make your stay that little bit special we will do our very best to assist you in every way possible.
tagline: A refreshingly warm welcome awaits you at Purbeck Holiday Lets

title: Locksbrook Lodge
subtitle: Surrounded by the lush greenery of one of Bath’s historic cemeteries, this beautiful and newly refurbished lodge house sleeps up to 10 guests in comfort and style.
bodyContent: Locksbrook Lodge is a Grade II listed, four-bedroom holiday home near Bath, set beside Locksbrook Cemetery off Upper Bristol Road. Sleeping ten, it has a fully equipped kitchen, sheltered private garden, off-road parking and WiFi. Just 25 minutes' riverside walk from Bath's historic centre, perfect for larger groups.
tagline: Surrounded by the lush greenery of one of Bath’s historic cemeteries

title: Hope Place
subtitle: Just a stone’s throw from the Royal Crescent, Hope Place is a luxurious one bed elevated apartment within a Grade II listed development delivering panoramic views of the city of Bath and the Avon Valley.
bodyContent: Situated in the prestigious residential suburb of Lansdown, just a stones throw from The Royal Crescent, nestled in the treasured Bath Conservation Area, Hope Place is a top of the range, modern and stylish residence. Whether you are looking for a weekend break, a self-catered home from home, a holiday or accommodation whilst on business, Hope Place provides a luxurious stay in the heart of the beautiful city of Bath. Throughout the apartment you will find decadent and exquisite touches to ensure your stay is one of pure indulgence. The open plan living room and dining area consists of stylish, contemporary furniture and decoration offering a comfortable and relaxing place to unwind. The kitchen is fully equipped with all you need to enjoy a premium break, including a Nespresso machine and Denby and Le Creuset crockery. The table is perfectly situated to allow you to enjoy breathtaking views over Bath and six acres of private parkland as you dine. For your entertainment there is a Sonos music bluetooth device together with a 43 inch smart television that has Netflix and Amazon video. The bedroom offers a peaceful and tranquil space to rest. The deluxe flower feature wall induces a sense of calm as you sink into the sumptuous Simba mattress, duvet and pillows and White Company bed linen. The room is opulently decorated and furnished with top of the range lighting, a Hollywood style mirror and a 43 inch smart television with Netflix and Amazon video. Discover the spectacular and captivating views across the city from this serene accommodation. On entering the bathroom you will find a range of luxurious Bramleys toiletries to indulge in. Take a long radiant soak in the bath or enjoy a fully immersive and energising shower under the extravagant rainfall shower head. Dry off with plush Christy towels and relax in the White Company Hydrocotton dressing gowns that are provided for your ultimate comfort.
tagline: Just a stone’s throw from the Royal Crescent, Hope Place is a luxurious one bed elevated apartment

title: Wookey Hole Hotel
subtitle: Wookey Hole Hotel is 20 minutes from the oldest medieval city in the UK Wells and sixty minutes from the City of Bath so well positioned for all local locations.
bodyContent: Come and stay at the Wookey Hole Hotel for great value family breaks all year round. Ideally placed in the heart of Somerset, the Wookey Hole Hotel can boast comfortable accommodation in picturesque surroundings. Receive access when you book directly! The Wookey Hole Hotel, located on the southern edge of the rolling Mendip Hills , lies in the Sleepy village of Wookey Hole, with easy access to the historic city of Wells and its stunning Cathedral. The Mendip Hills have been recognised as an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty and offer stunning landscapes of sweeping slopes and limestone gorges, with endless walking trails and sightseeing spots. Traverse the Mendips and the hills fall away to the breath-taking lakes of the Chew Valley, just a short drive from Wookey Hole. Also close by are Cheddar Gorge and the ancient town of Glastonbury , with Bath, Bristol and the beaches of Burnham-on-Sea and Weston-Super-Mare slightly further afield. The Hotel includes free and secure car and coach parking, modern bedrooms with free wifi plus a stylish Bar and Bistro. The perfect place for a family break or special occasion - we look forward to welcoming you! And of course, discounted tickets to Wookey Hole Caves and attractions!
tagline: Come and stay at The West Country’s newest hotel. Great value family breaks all year round.

title: Queensberry Estates Ltd
subtitle: Queensberry Estates offers 5 beautiful properties in central Bath available all year round for short break holiday rentals.
bodyContent: Right in the centre of Bath is Bath Townhouse. This amazing 5 storey Georgian Townhouse is divided into two apartments, sleeping 14 or 9 or can be combined to sleep 23. Perfect for groups who prefer to be in the centre of Bath, you are able to walk to the shops, bars, restaurants and sites! The Thermae Bath Spa is only 2 minutes walk away! The property has a stylish interior with modern facilities, quality fixtures and fittings and many original features. Bath Townhouse 14 boasts 6 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a large fully equipped kitchen with large dining table to seat 14. A spacious lounge offers comfortable seating for socialising and entertaining. Bath Townhouse 8 has 3 bedrooms sleeping 8 plus a sofa bed in the games room for a 9th person. There are 3 luxury bathrooms, and an open plan kitchen, lounge, dining room. Fully equipped for self catering. In the basement the vault has been converted into a games room with wall mounted widescreen TV, Xbox, table football. No parking on site - but several public car parks are a 2 minute walk away. Bath Spa train and coach station are a 5 minute walk. Bath View Four & Two are two smaller apartments just 10 minutes walk away from the city centre in the conservation area of Oldfield Park. This quiet residential area of Bath has beautiful views over the World Heritage City of Bath. Bath View Four can sleep 5 people in two bedrooms with 2 bathrooms, lounge and kitchen. A spacious apartment that is fully equipped for self catering breaks. Children are welcome. Bath View Two has a king size bedroom, wet room and lounge/kitchen area. Perfect for one or two people. Space for a cot. Small pets welcome. Both apartments have free off street parking. Bath West House is located 2 miles from the centre of Bath in a quiet residential area. It is a modern house with large open plan ground floor. A spacious kitchen-diner, lounge area has bio-fold doors opening on to a pretty, secluded garden with patio area and seating. There are 6 bedrooms sleeping up to 10 people, a family bathroom, shower room and additional WC and utility room. One free parking place in the driveway with free residential on-street parking. A regular bus service stops right outside. Perfect for groups who would like to be based in a quieter part of Bath but within easy access of everything Bath has to offer. We offer short breaks, 2 nights over a weekend and 3 nights minimum stay mid-week. We market and service all our properties and can therefore provide a friendly service with local knowledge and advise.
tagline: Queensberry Estates offers 5 beautiful properties in central Bath available all year round

bodyContent: Hayleaze Cottage is the perfect base for a rural retreat. Rural features include a stable door on arrival, an open-plan living room and kitchen with exposed beams. The comfortable leather sofa is perfect for unwinding after a busy day of exploring. The bedroom has a comfortable double bed, wardrobe and enough room for a cot if you bring your baby or toddler with you (Cot can be provided – please state this when booking). Located on the edge of the village of Winsley, 2 miles from Bradford on Avon. Bath is 5 miles away. There is a direct bus which goes to the centre every 30 mins. The Indoor Pool and Games Room is big hit with other guests. It is like a big bath, at 32 degrees! All within a mile: Hartley Farm Shop/Kitchen , The Seven Stars pub and a village shop

title: Quern Barn
subtitle: Steart Marshes and the beautiful River Parrett Estuary on the doorstep . This peaceful, relaxing location is perfect for walkers, bird watchers and photographers.
bodyContent: Steart Marshes and the beautiful River Parrett Estuary on the doorstep . This peaceful, relaxing location is perfect for walkers, bird watchers and photographers. A sixteenth century barn lovingly converted in 2010 to provide an idyllic peaceful retreat. Nestled behind the owners Riverside Farmhouse on the southeast corner of Steart Marshes adjacent to the Parrett Trail, it is an ideal location for nature lovers and those wishing to explore the beautiful county do Somerset. A very warm welcome awaits you at this beautifully converted barn sitting on the edge of The Steart Marshes Nature Reserve in a very peaceful setting. Stunning walks from the doorstep along the ever changing and spectacular Parrett Estuary will lead you through a working wetland to the Steart Peninsula “a wild and wonderful spot on the Somerset Levels” Simon Barnes Sunday Times April 2017. Quern Barn was converted by the current owners in 2010, retaining much of the original character and uncovering a “Quern stone” dating back to the 11th Century. The accommodation is cosy and of a premium standard, being consistently highly rated by over 200 guests and ranking it in the top 5 of over 600 cottages on the “managing agents” happiness survey reports . Overview: Sleeps 4 2 Bedrooms 1 Bathroom Quern Barn offers the perfect location to explore the length and breadth of Somerset from the beautiful rolling hills such as the Quantocks , and Exmoor National Park , to the Coastal Path covering Brean to Minehead . After a day of exploring enjoy a rest in the hammocks in the top paddock and take in the view of the estuary, the Mendip hills and beyond. The accommodation comprises of an open plan lounge /dining area with off set galley kitchen complete with everything you may need. The master bedroom has a very comfortable king size bed, with a further bedroom providing twin beds and there is a wet room all with exposed ceiling timbers. A utility area is located in a neighbouring barn. Externally there is a small enclosed garden/patio area with table and chairs and an adjacent parking space. Beyond this there is a wildlife Pond with a seated area to one end and there is a paddock which inclines up to a great viewing spot where the summerhouse is located. You are welcome to use these facilities. As the Pond is unfenced Quern Barn is not suitable for children under 8, except for pre-crawling babies. DO LOOK AT OUR WEBSITE FOR FULL PHOTO GALLERY AND DETAILS.
tagline: Steart Marshes and the beautiful River Parrett Estuary on the doorstep .

title: Grove Cottage
subtitle: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages set in the beautiful Wiltshire Countryside.
bodyContent: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages set in the beautiful Wiltshire Countryside on the edge of an area of outstanding natural beauty but only 5 miles from the world heritage city of Bath and 1 mile from the Saxon town of Bradford-on-Avon. Cumberwell Country Cottages are located on Great Cumberwell Farm, which has been in the James family since 1939 and was originally a dairy farm until 1992 when the herd was sold making way for a diversification into Cumberwell Park Golf Club, the farm itself has not changed a great deal and is still a working farm with over 300 acres of arable crop. The self-catering cottages available for your stay have been converted from an old tithe barn which has had many purposes in the past including stables, a grain store and cider production as the orchard at the front of the cottages was a cider apple orchard.
tagline: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages

title: Lorne House
subtitle: Lorne House is a large Victorian villa in the lovely Wiltshire village of Box, just six miles from the city of Bath.
bodyContent: Lorne House is a large Victorian villa in the lovely Wiltshire village of Box, just six miles from the city of Bath. We offer an elegant charm, gorgeous ensuite rooms and a very friendly, personal service. Lorne House provides an ideal base from which to explore Bath, the beautiful Wiltshire countryside and its many historic and beautiful local villages, including Lacock, Castle Combe, Bradford on Avon, Corsham and Avebury. The childhood home of Thomas the Tank Engine author, Reverend W.V.Awdry, Lorne House has been furnished to a very high standard; all our rooms are en-suite, with either wet-rooms or bathrooms, and come equipped with tea and coffee making facilities, hairdryer, flat screen television, iron and ironing board. There is free wifi throughout the house. Our breakfasts are hearty and substantial, with fruit, cereals, toast, traditional cooked English breakfast or continental options, served in our lovely light and spacious dining room. We source as many of our foodstuffs locally where possible and the marmalade is home-made. Guests have the choice of a comfy sitting room or a large outdoor verandah to relax and unwind.
tagline: Lorne House is a large Victorian villa in the lovely Wiltshire village of Box

title: Ultimate Coldplay
subtitle: The show features award winning Bouncing Beamz laser display.
bodyContent: The show features award winning Bouncing Beamz laser display. Since launching in 2017, Ultimate Coldplay have been widely recognized as being the world’s most accurate Coldplay tribute. They are the only Coldplay tribute featuring a true look-a-like Chris Martin, who plays piano and guitar like Chris, sings like Chris and even dances like him! The band have toured the world with tours of mainland Europe and Asia, as well countless festivals across the UK, theatre tours and regularly selling out venues such as 02 academies and beyond. Expect all the biggest hits spanning Coldplay’s two-decade back catalog including ‘Paradise’, ‘Fix You’, Viva la Vida’, ‘My Universe’ and ‘Yellow’. Right up to the latest hits such as ‘Higher Power’ and ‘Feels like i'm falling in love’

title: Riscombe Farm Holiday Cottages
subtitle: Four self catering stone cottages in Somerset on Exmoor surrounded by attractive courtyard. Centre of Exmoor National Park. Very peaceful beside River Exe. Log fires.
bodyContent: Down a quiet country lane, beside the River Exe, in the heart of Exmoor National Park , Riscombe offers four charming cottages converted from stone barns around an attractive courtyard. Comfortable and well-equipped, with exposed beams and log fires in the three larger cottages. Full central heating throughout. Pets are welcome, and stabling is available if you want to bring your horse. Our small-holding has a variety of friendly animals - ponies, sheep, pygmy goats, chickens, ducks and more. Visit the nearby spectacular coast (just 15 minutes away) heather moorland, lovely valleys, woodlands, historic villages and great pubs. Short breaks available and last minute offers. DO CALL DIRECT, NO COMMISSION, NO HIDDEN FEES, SIMPLY THE BEST PRICE. We look forward to meeting you!
tagline: Four self catering stone cottages in Somerset on Exmoor surrounded by attractive courtyard.

title: Lowdens Guest House
subtitle: Lowdens Guesthouse offers comfortable accommodation with a warm welcome.
bodyContent: Just minutes from Taunton town centre, ideal for business or leisure. Nine en suite guest rooms across three floors, each with Freeview TV and tea/coffee facilities. Free wifi and parking included. Room-only rates, with plenty of nearby cafes and restaurants offering something for every taste and budget.

title: Group accommodation sleeping 16
subtitle: Group accommodation, sleeping 16 guests across 3 cotswold cottages. Optional space for up to 22 guests using rooms from the BnB. Walking distance of castle Combe village and 20 minutes from the city of Bath.
bodyContent: Our group accommodation comprises our three cotswolds cottages, sleeping up to 16 guests in six bedrooms and six bathrooms. Dovecote , a loft apartment, sleeps up to 4 guests. Garden House , situated in an 18th Century dairy building, sleeps 6 guests. The Stables , as it is named, was a former cotswold stone stable building. Six guests can stay here across the three bedrooms. There is also a group dining room in The Stables cottage and a large catering kitchen. This is perfect to suit a family, group of friends or even a Hen Do. The three cottages allow each group of guests to branch off to their own private areas but come together for dining and socialising. Location Located within walking distance of the stunning Cotswolds village of Castle Combe and just 20 minutes from the centre of Bath. The cottages also benefit from many local walking and cycling routes. Local group mini bus transport is available just contact us for further details. Please contact us or check our website for last minute offers – https://www.fossefarmhouse.com/ Additional accommodation We are also able to offer additional rooms at our BnB, when booked in conjunction with the cottages this allows for up to 22 guests in total. Families often use this option when attending weddings in the nearby villages of Castle Combe, Grittleton and Euridge.
tagline: Group accommodation, sleeping 16 guests across 3 cotswold cottages

title: Rosary Cottage

title: Rose Lodge
subtitle: Perfect for nature lovers and walkers, this detached, eco-friendly lodge has a private hot tub and is situated in a rural position with outstanding views across the Somerset Levels.
bodyContent: Rose Lodge is set within the owners’ grounds, but benefits from its own private garden as well as the use of the larger grounds. The lodge has been lovingly converted from a former mobile home with cedar cladding, log burner and double glazing. After a day spent exploring this beautiful part of the country, you can relax in the inviting hot tub and unwind whilst savouring the outstanding 180-degree view across the Somerset Levels. The hot tub is completely private and for your exclusive use during your stay and towelling robes and slippers are provided to enhance your hot tub experience. There are lovely country walks over rural footpaths straight from the door, fishing, golf and quaint village pubs nearby. The Somerset Levels, with their abundance of wildlife and nature reserves, are on the doorstep, or you can explore the many other places of interest. Within easy driving distance are many historic houses such as Muchelney Abbey, Forde Abbey, and National Trust’s Montacute House and Tintinhull House.Try some retail therapy at the shopping outlet of Clarks Village; discover Glastonbury with its enchanting tor and abbey; or drive on to the cathedral city of Wells with its Bishops Palace and character shops. Further afield, the Roman spa town of Bath is well worth a visit, as well as the county town of Taunton, and further on, the Quantock Hills and Exmoor National Park. If you have time, spend a day or two in west Dorset and explore the famous World Heritage Jurassic Coast. You will have much to do for a fulfilling holiday. Beach 22 miles. Shop 1½ miles, pub and restaurant 1 mile. 15 steps to entrance. All on the ground floor Open plan living space: With tiled floor Living area: With wood burner and Freeview TV Dining area Kitchen area: With gas hob/ electric oven, microwave, fridge/freezer and dishwasher Bedroom 1: With double bed Room 2: With 4ft double bed (can be 2ft twin beds on request) 2 towels per person, towelling robe and slippers for your comfort whilst using the hot tub Shower room: With shower cubicle and toilet Heating and hot water is from the Eco Biomass wood pellet boiler. Gas, electricity, bed linen, towels and Wi-Fi included. Initial logs for wood burner included, remainder at cost. Highchair. Utility room with washing machine and tumble dryer (shared with owners). Private parking for 2 cars. No smoking. Please note: There is an unfenced pond in the garden.

Report highlights

Hotel room occupancy for August 2025 was 81%, on par with August 2024.  2024. Room supply fell by 3.8% year on year, whilst demand declined slightly more, by 4.2% suggesting a slight downturn. Year to date (Jan-Aug) occupancy for 2025 was 78%, on par with the same period for 2024.

Observing forward looking occupancy for the upcoming 3 months of 2025. As of the 12th September, occupancy rates committed so far for September 2025 were 64%, followed by 28% for October and 15% for November 2025. These rates will rise as the month matures and more bookings are made. 

Average Daily Rates for England decreased by 3% in August 2025 to £157, with RevPAR  (Revenue per Available Room) also decreasing compared to August 2024 (-3% to £127). ADR for England excluding London was £99 (+1%), and RevPAR was £78 (+1%).

Regionally, the South West and West Midlands both recorded increases in occupancy compared to August 2024, rising by 5% and 4% respectively. In contrast, the South East saw the biggest decline, with occupancy falling by 4% for this region.

The larger hotels had the highest room occupancy in August, at 84% occupation for hotels with 300+ rooms, 1% lower than August 2024.

title: Garden Apartment
subtitle: The Garden Apartment is a luxury 2 bedroom Georgian Grade II apartment in the heart of Bath.
bodyContent: This apartment has recently been refurbished to a very high standard and offers spacious accommodation arranged over 2 floors covering a very spacious 90m2 each. The Garden Apartment is an absolute gem providing luxury accommodation within a Grade II listed Georgian Terrace in the heart of Bath. Have a peaceful and relaxing stay right in the centre of Bath and enjoy all that the city has to offer within easy walking distance. With close proximity to the train station, shops, restaurants, cafes and local attractions this is the perfect place to stay and make your base. The accommodation is in a Grade II Listed Georgian building situated on a very quiet street less than a 3 minutes walk from Bath Spa station and Bath city centre shops, restaurants and cafes. The property also has access to a garage. The apartment has just been refurbished to a very high standard and offers spacious accommodation for up to 4 guests arranged over 2 floors covering a very spacious 90m2. The property offers two generous sized bedrooms, both have Kingsize beds with Vi Spring mattresses. Crisp white linen and fluffy towels are provided. Both bedrooms have a luxury but minimalist feel and are finished with linen roman blinds. There is also a private garden with seating to enjoy the early and evening sun and wonderful views out across the city. The lounge has period features and is equipped with a large HDTV and makes a great space for relaxing. The connecting kitchen/dining area has gorgeous views over the garden, Bath city centre and surrounding hills. The kitchen is a fully equipped with modern oven, induction hob, dishwasher, fridge-freezer, extractor fan, toaster and kettle. A waste and recycling bins are provided. The modern bathroom is fitted with a bath and over shower and has under floor heating. There are efficient radiators in all rooms so the apartment is always warm and cozy. There is an additional cloakroom and WC. An iron and ironing board, and travel cot are provided. The Garden Apartment really is the perfect place to come to for your self catering break in Bath. For more information or to enquire about your preferred dates, please contact us today . Direct Booking Discounts & Special Offers Join our Mailing List and become eligible to use the discount code below. Discount Code – Valid for Direct Bookings Only. Please use code MB5OFF-20 at the Availability Page to gain a 5% discount.
tagline: The Garden Apartment is a luxury 2 bedroom Georgian Grade II apartment

title: Ships Mews
subtitle: Four Self Catering studio apartments - Independently managed accommodation.
bodyContent: Ships Mews is a detached holiday property located at the western end of the High Street in the charming village of Porlock, Somerset. An excellent holiday location to enjoy the natural wonders and superb scenery of Exmoor National Park and the dramatic coastline in this region. The studio apartments are stylishly furnished, with open plan living space, comprising of a kitchen & dining area, seating and sleeping area. Facilities include; *Free WiFi *Free Parking for one car *King size bed *En-suite shower room *Flat screen Freesat TV *Two seater sofa *Well appointed kitchen (Fridge/Oven/Microwave/Hob) *Towels and bed linen included *Electric heating The apartments are situated at the bottom of Porlock Hill, one mile from the sea, approximately ten to fifteen minutes walk away, with the beautiful Porlock Weir only five minutes away by car. Within short walking distance of an excellent selection of shops to cater for your holiday needs during your stay. These include two well stocked convenience stores, pubs, restaurants, tearooms all serving quality food and drink. Other shops include a Post Office (stocked with country living accessories), Pharmacy, Cheese shop, ATM, Art gallery, gift shops and more… Other places of interest include the Dovery Manor Museum containing a wealth of information relating to local history. There are two Churches on the High Street, Porlock Methodist Church and St. Dubricius Church, dedicated to the 7th Century Welsh Saint, said to have crowned King Arthur. Also within a short drive are the the pretty Victorian villages of Lynton and Lynmouth to the west and the bustling holiday town of Minehead to the east. Further west takes you to the enchanting medieval Dunster Castle (National Trust). There are beaches at Dunster and Blue Anchor with the historic harbour village of Watchet just along the coast. **Minimum 2 night stay** Access details - key code & parking information emailed prior to your arrival. Check in: 16.00 / Check out: 10.00 A security deposit of £80.00 is required and subject to a damage inspection of the accommodation. * Adults only * * No Pets * AA **** Four Star Self Catering - 2020 Quality Inspected.

title: Fishermen’s Retreat
subtitle: A veritable rural retreat, Fishermen’s Retreat is an award winning haven of calm where you can totally escape from the bustle of Bath and relax in the beautiful Midford Valley beside the Midford Brook.
bodyContent: One of a rank of 4 cottages built for the Somerset Coal Canal workers in the late 1800s and renovated today to 4 Star standard and has now been awarded a Gold Star for exceptional accommodation and welcome. Sleeping facilities are on the first floor with a king size luxury 1400 pocket sprung bed in the master bedroom with crisp Egyptian cotton linen and a small overnight guest room. There is also a sofabed in the sitting room. With the original fireplace and wood burning stove the sitting room is very welcoming and comfortable. There is also a pine dining table for 4 in the window alcove so you can watch the birds feeding as you eat. This is more like a home than a holiday cottage. Just outside the front door there is a small private patio with table and chairs where you can pop out for a quick cup of coffee and admire the roses. Fishermen’s Retreat has a south facing mature garden leading down to the Midford brook where there is a stone built barbecue on the brookside patio. There is nothing more enjoyable than relaxing with a glass of wine while your cook is at work! Wildlife abounds here with a variety of birds..kingfishers, warblers, heron, cormorants all frequent visitors, preying on the local trout. AROUND AND ABOUT The Brook is a fishery stocked by the Avon Anglers and day tickets can be purchased for fly fishing. Need to be organised in advance. Alternatively, you can enjoy the many walks and cycle rides around: Sustrans 24 is just above the cottage and you are not be more than 300 yards along the road from the famous Two Tunnel Cycle way into Bath. The Kennet and Avon Canal path also provides excellent cycling opportunities and you can cycle one way i to Bath and the other to Bradford on Avon and Devizes. Wild swimming is available at Warleigh Weir and Farleigh Hungerford, 2-4 miles away Maps are supplied in all cottages. MEDIA FACILITIES There is free Wifi throughout the cottage and a flat screen TV in the sitting room. An iPod Docking station is also provided. There is a selection of DVDs, a variety of books as well as some board games. PARKING Free private parking space for one car is provided and a second by arrangement ABOUT TUCKING MILL SELF CATERING Fishermen’s Retreat is one of the five 4 Star Luxury Gold properties in Tucking Mill Self Catering owned by Michael and Ann. There are two apartments in the city centre, The Old Smithy Loft and No 2 Hedgemead Court, and two other cottages Brooks’ View and Tucking Mill View just 12 minutes drive away at Tucking Mill, Midford, a historic hamlet just outside the city boundaries in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. REWARD CARD All our guests benefit from the Reward Card and you can enjoy exclusive discounts for many of the city’s restaurants and cafes. One special deal is the 3 hour session for the price of 2 at the Thermae Spa – Mon-Fri. THOSE LOOKING AFTER YOU The property is managed by the Family Team..With Ann who has a background in hospitality and much travelling, Michael who built the barbecues and is in charge of logs, bird feeding and Head housekeeper Nikki the team will do its utmost to ensure you enjoy your stay. You will also likely meet our invaluable man of all trades, Rob Short or long breaks available.
tagline: A veritable rural retreat, Fishermen’s Retreat is an award winning haven of calm

title: Fig Cottage
subtitle: Fig Cottage is immersed in idyllic countryside and bordered by National Trust gardens, yet just 20 minutes from the magical city of Bath and a five-minute walk from great pubs and cafes.
bodyContent: Fig Cottage is a light, airy cottage, tucked away in the pretty village of Holt. It is nestled in the grounds of a Grade II listed house, bordering The Courts National Trust gardens and open meadows. The modern kitchen is fully equipped with a Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, oven, hob and microwave. There’s also a fridge freezer, dishwasher and washing machine. However, if you’d like someone else to do the hard work for you, stroll round the corner to one of our fantastic village pubs and cafes. Holt has award winning cuisine, delicious brunches, scrumptious cakes and an excellent cup of tea or coffee. Fig Cottage has a spacious living area, with a comfy sofa, easy chair and double doors leading onto a private decked area. For dining and relaxation, there is also a pretty courtyard garden. Relax on the comfortable sofa or armchair indoors, watch the flat screen TV, listen to the stereo system or get stuck into a novel. There is fast WIFI, plus access to Netflix and other on demand TV. The pretty, vintage style bedroom has a superbly comfortable King size bed, made by luxury bed makers Loaf. Sink into crisp white bed linen and a feather duvet at night. At Fig Cottage , we are more than happy to provide a cot for any infant visitors, plus there is a sofa bed in the living area, which can accommodate two children or one adult (two adults if you’re prepared to be a little cosy). There is a large, walk in rainfall shower in the bathroom and fluffy white cotton towels. There are a wealth of activities in the local area. The world famous city of Bath is just a 20 minute drive away and Bradford-on-Avon is just five minutes by car. There you’ll find a wealth of independent shops, beautiful houses and churches, and miles of canal towpath to explore by bike, boat or foot. The Courts Gardens and Great Chalfield Manor (where Poldark was filmed) are both within walking distance, and Lacock Abbey, Dyrham Park, Iford Manor, Stourhead Gardens, Avebury Manor, Longleat and Bowood are all within easy reach. Bristol, with its aquarium, bustling waterfront and great shopping makes for a great day out too.
tagline: Fig Cottage is immersed in idyllic countryside

title: Marlborough House
subtitle: Marlborough House is an enchanting Victorian Town House which has received 4 Stars and Gold Award for quality and service, and is operated by Peter Moore in a friendly and informal style.
bodyContent: Marlborough House is an enchanting Victorian Town House which has received 4 Stars and Gold Award for quality and service, and is operated by Peter Moore in a friendly and informal style. Marlborough House is in a great location. Conveniently located to all of Bath’s major attractions. The Royal Crescent, Circus, Assembly Rooms. Guild Hall, Abbey, Roman Baths, Thermae spas are all within a 2 – 15 minutes walk. Marlborough guest house, has 6 fully air conditioned, en-suite rooms, retaining many period features, and have been elegantly furnished to create a relaxing atmosphere. All rooms are different, some accommodate a family of 3 or 4. Have a minimum of a king size or superking size bed, one has an antique four poster bed. Our award wining breakfasts are served between 8.30-10 am, includes an abundant selection of freshly prepared fruit, cereals and yoghurts, followed by a choice of cooked to order vegetarian breakfasts. We have parking in our forecourt, and 3 special parking permits, please check availability of parking with us, prior to booking. Guests can check into Marlborough House any time between 11.30 am – 1.00 pm. or between 4.30 – 6.30 pm. Arriving outside of these times is by prior arrangement with the proprietor and before booking anywhere “on – line” Good discounts available for stays 3 of nights or more Sundays to Thursdays

title: Dash Corner Cottage
subtitle: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages set in the beautiful Wiltshire Countryside.
bodyContent: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages set in the beautiful Wiltshire Countryside on the edge of an area of outstanding natural beauty but only 5 miles from the world heritage city of Bath and 1 mile from the Saxon town of Bradford-on-Avon. Cumberwell Country Cottages are located on Great Cumberwell Farm, which has been in the James family since 1939 and was originally a dairy farm until 1992 when the herd was sold making way for a diversification into Cumberwell Park Golf Club, the farm itself has not changed a great deal and is still a working farm with over 300 acres of arable crop. The self-catering cottages available for your stay have been converted from an old tithe barn which has had many purposes in the past including stables, a grain store and cider production as the orchard at the front of the cottages was a cider apple orchard.
tagline: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages

title: Somerset Country Escape
subtitle: VisitEngland 4-5 star luxury self-catering converted barns with your own hot tub and garden for 2 -7 guests.
bodyContent: We provide VisitEngland 4-5 star, luxury self-catering accommodation with your own hot tub and garden for 2-7 guests. Our beautifully converted stone barns are nestled in breath-taking surroundings on a cider farm! It’s a rural hideaway, where you can enjoy a countryside break in a rustic yet comfortable and well-appointed 4-5 star holiday cottage. We look forward to welcoming you here soon. Accommodation includes: The Granary The Granary is a charming, 4-star Gold converted barn with exclusive hot tub and secluded garden. This self-catering cottage sleeps max 5 with a modern kitchen and open plan kitchen/dining/living space. There are two classic bedrooms with en-suites on the second floor. VisitBritain 4 Star GOLD | Ample parking | WiFi | Sleeps 2- 5 The Barn The Barn is a self-catering barn conversion that has been tastefully converted to sleep 2-6 with 2 bedrooms on the ground floor and 1 in a mezzanine – it is a great place to stay for the whole family! French glass doors lead out into a enclosed patio and hot tub area, where you can also enjoy a BBQ. The original, beautiful timber beams and flooring run throughout the open plan kitchen/dining area – which is fully-equipped for you all your requirements on your holiday. VisitBritain 4 Star GOLD | Ample parking | WiFi | Sleeps 2- 6 The Old Mill The Old Mill is a 300-year-old barn that has been lovingly converted enhancing its original features. It is fully equipped for your self-catering requirements in a designer kitchen. A beautiful oak spiral staircase leads upstairs and french doors open to the garden where you can enjoy a BBQ. title: Cumberwell Country Cottages Benzes Mead Cottage
subtitle: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages.
bodyContent: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages offers 7 award winning unique, luxurious and spacious self-catering cottages set in the beautiful Wiltshire Countryside on the edge of an area of outstanding natural beauty but only 5 miles from the world heritage city of Bath and 1 mile from the Saxon town of Bradford-on-Avon. Cumberwell Country Cottages are located on Great Cumberwell Farm, which has been in the James family since 1939 and was originally a dairy farm until 1992 when the herd was sold making way for a diversification into Cumberwell Park Golf Club, the farm itself has not changed a great deal and is still a working farm with over 300 acres of arable crop. The self-catering cottages available for your stay have been converted from an old tithe barn which has had many purposes in the past including stables, a grain store and cider production as the orchard at the front of the cottages was a cider apple orchard. Cumberwell is believed to have links with the Doomsday book when Cumberwell Manor used to exist at the top of the Farmhouse Garden, until it burnt down – Rumoured to have been by a cigarette left alight by the drunken butler!! The Farm where the cottages are located has been in the James family since 1939. Originally and for 55 years it was a dairy farm until 1992 when the dairy cows were sold making way for a diversification into Cumberwell Park Golf Club. The original Great Cumberwell Farm and its buildings have not changed a great deal over the years and in fact we still farm over 300 acres of arable each year, crops including Wheat, Barley and Oilseed Rape. The Cottages you can stay in have been converted from an old tythe barn, which has been restored with its original character in mind. Each cottage has taken its name from an original field on the farm, many of which have now been taken over by the golf course. The original tythe barn had many uses over the years.
tagline: Set in a peaceful, rural location, Cumberwell Country Cottages

title: Crescent Apartment
subtitle: New luxury self catering/ serviced apartment in Bath. City centre location, 5 minutes walk to the Circus and world famous Royal Crescent.
bodyContent: Enjoying an excellent city centre location, Bath Circle is a newly built Georgian town house, offering luxurious serviced accommodation 5 minutes walk from Royal Crescent and The Circus, making it ideal to explore the city and beyond. The apartments are available for short and medium term lets. All are furnished to the highest standard and every detail has been carefully considered. Crescent Apartment (2 bed apartment, plus sofabed, sleeps up to 5) is on the lower ground floor and the Circus Apartment (1 bed apartment, plus sofabed, sleeps up to 4) is on the first floor of a Georgian townhouse. The apartments are built to the highest standard with quality and comfort in mind. The Crescent apartment comprises an open-plan sitting room/ kitchen, master bedroom, single bedroom, bathroom and elegant French doors leading to the courtyard. The sitting room is furnished with two sofas (one is a sofa bed), LCD TV & DVD, Hi-Fi with a dock for your iPhone or iPad and a dining table suitable for six people. The master bedroom has a super king size deep-sprung divan bed, which can be converted into twin beds, fitted wardrobe, console table and stool and flat-screen television. The bedding is fine percale cotton linen with a luxurious mattress topper and completed with a feather-light goose down duvet and pillows. The second bedroom has a single deep-sprung divan bed with similar bedding to the master bedroom. The quality modern kitchen has been carefully planned and fitted; fully equipped with Neff induction hob, electric oven and integrated appliances: including a microwave, dishwasher, washer/dryer, fridge and separate freezer. The contemporary bathroom is fitted with Villeroy and Boch sanitary ware consisting of a bath, shower, wall-hung toilet, sink, and includes Duck Island toiletries and luxury bath sheets. On your arrival you will find some of life essentials in a complimentary welcome basket.

title: Sparkford Hall
subtitle: The grand but secluded Grade II Georgian mansion that is Sparkford Hall boasts incredible rooms, grounds and outbuildings that we just love putting to use for unique, memorable and exclusive private events, all year round. We are a dog friendly venue.
bodyContent: THE MAIN HALL Running the width of the house, the main hall is a brilliant space with a wide range of possible uses including wedding ceremonies, banquets, live music, seminar room and much more. - Party space for up to 150 - - Wedding ceremony for up to 80 - - Bar options available from our preferred suppliers - - Ideal for live bands, DJs etc - - Can be themed in any style - THE LIBRARY - Licensed for small wedding ceremonies up to 25… perfect for intimate formal proceedings before moving onto a party with the rest of your guests. - - “Casino Night” option - - “Piano Room” option - - Can be themed in any style - THE GALLERY Right in the centre of the main building the Gallery is a great space to welcome guests, serve drinks, or offer a chance to mingle. Built-in bar area at your disposal. - Versatile space in the centre of the house - - Great for speeches/announcements - - Built in bar/reception area - OUR ROOMS Sparkford Hall is decorated in keeping with the period of the house but with a modern twist. Think elegant antiques with contemporary art and simple coloured furnishing. The house boasts grand ensuite main bedrooms, plus several bunk and twin rooms and several shared bathrooms. All the bedrooms have fabulous views bringing the countryside indoors, and the highest quality duvets, linen and towels are provided. - 11 bedrooms total - - 6 ensuite master rooms - - 1 bunk room - - rooms can be set up as twin rooms - - 4 separate bathrooms - - high quality bedding and towels provided - - Each room has a stunning view of the grounds -

title: New Barn Cottage B&B
subtitle: Julie,Mike Smy welcome you to our friendly family run bed and breakfast.
bodyContent: In the heart of Somerset in a rural location, just one mile from the M5 junction 25, Set back off the main A358. You will be staying in a newly built dorma bungalow. We have two rooms both are en-suite, a ground floor double room which has a shower, first floor family/double/ twin room which has bath and shower. All rooms have tea, coffee making facilities, freeview TV. English breakfast is served with eggs from our own hens. We have a large kitchen and dining area where breakfast is served, you can also have a continental breakfast if you wish. Plenty of off road parking. We are ideal place to stay for a stop over to Devon, Cornwall for a base for touring the wast country.The West Somerset railway (Steam Trains) is only 20 minute drive away. Just 5 minutes away there is a 10 pin bowling ally, multi screen cinema. We are on a bus route. From our home you can reach the north Somerset coast (Weston supermare) in 30 minutes and the south coast( Lyme Regis ) You are only 3 miles away from Taunton, which will provide you with excellent shopping, Taunton has a good selection of restaurants.Somerset County Cricket Ground, Taunton Museum. Taunton race course is only a short drive away. The Taunton Bridgewater canal is a short drive away or walk. Taunton Vale golf club is only 10 minutes away.

subtitle: Cow Byre 1 AND 2 Cottages are two lovely semi-detached, spacious, interconnecting, two bedroomed cottages (so four) each sleeping up to five so ten in all.
bodyContent: Cow Byre 1 AND 2 Cottages are two lovely semi-detached, spacious, interconnecting, two bedroomed cottages (so four) each sleeping up to five so ten in all. They situated in a semi-rural location just outside Bradford-on-Avon on an old farm with one other cottage and B&B rooms. The B&B rooms can be used as additional ensuite rooms if you need more bedrooms for a gathering of family or friends. The cottages overlook agricultural fields to the rear and an enclosed patios to the front. These charming cottages each feature a fully equipped kitchen, log burning stove, exposed wooden beams, electric heating, wi-fi internet access, Freeview television with DVD player aswell as a BBQ and patio. Bed linens are provided. There is also a games room, children play area and games field. Our pets and other free ranging animals include two Shetland ponies, two over friendly English Setters, two black cats and various hens and ducks. Bath is a pleasant short train journey taking you right to the town centre meaning you dont have to navigate the one way system and then find a car park! Lastly we offer 30% off day tickets for nearby Longleat and 25% off tickets for Cheddar Gorge and Caves. We hope you will choose us for your stay near Bath. *Late Availability Discounts*

title: Spindlewood Lodges
subtitle: Spindlewood Lodges is a small park of just 7 log cabins set in 10 acres of pasture, woodland and orchards with stunning views of the surrounding countryside and Glastonbury Tor.
bodyContent: An ideal location for those people who want to experience the peace and quiet the countryside has to offer, with your own outdoor space rather than being right next to your neighbours in a large holiday park. Your short break accommodation is a traditional Scandanavian log cabin. All of our log cabins sleep up to 4 people and are deceptively spacious with 2 bedrooms – one double and one twin. All have a combined modern kitchen/diner with countryside views and you can relax indoors in the spacious lounge with leather sofas or outside on the large south facing covered veranda. We’re surrounded by many different beautiful locations with wonderful wildlife and major attractions. You can read about some of our favourite local attractions and local restaurants across our site. So why not visit us for a short break or weekend to escape everyday life?

bodyContent: Situated in a quiet mews in the centre of Wells, 8 Bishops Mews is perfectly situated next to the High Street. title: Coachmans Cottage
subtitle: Enjoy peace and quiet in a Beautiful Wiltshire Village. Close to the Wiltshire/Somerset Border. BA14 6HH
bodyContent: If you are looking for peace and quiet, but want to be part of a village community then Coachmans Cottage is THE COTTAGE for you. An immaculate, stand alone, all ground floor, 1 bedroom cottage, managed by the owner who lives next door. Set in the heart of the beautiful conservation village of Steeple Ashton in Wiltshire. Stunning 365 days of the year. Classic, Immaculate. Individual. Comfortable. Perfect to unwind and enjoy life at a slower pace. Yet only a car or train journey into the centre of Bath. Sorry No Children, Infants, Babies or pets. Immediately feel at home the spacious 18′ sitting/dining room, furnished with Georgian style mahogany and comfortable sofas, With Freeview T.V., WiFi. The wonderfully comfortable 16′ Master Bedroom has a Super King Size Bed with 1800 pocket sprung mattress. Bring your own bedding, bed linen, etc.. Also there is a spacious office/study/dressing room. The kitchen is separate and although SMALL is well equipped with a dishwasher, washer/drier, fridge with icebox, oven and hob. The sparkling bathroom has a full size bath with power shower over, loo and basin. Bring your own towels etc.. All of the ground floor accommodation is accessed from the hall. The cottage has full central heating, constant hot water, and is double glazed. Please phone me, Penny, on +44(0)1380 870764 for information on the cottage and area and just for the simple reassurance of speaking to a real person. You can see much more at https://www.coachmans-cottage.com Steeple Ashton village never fails to charms guests, as one once commented “like Midsomer without the murders”. There is a walkable pub that serves good food, and a walkable award winning community shop. The fine architecture, and magnificent St Mary’s Church cannot help but impress. Only 12 miles from Bath. If you do not feel like driving into the city then hop onto the train at one of the local train stations in Trowbridge, Westbury Melksham or Bradford on Avon.

title: Stay Wells and Somerset - Apartment 1
subtitle: Stylish two bed flat, Wells City Centre, free parking Enjoy a comfortable stay at this stylish centrally-located two bedroom flat. The Guard House is a historic building within a few steps of Wells High Street. The Cathedral, Vicars Close and Bishop's Palace are all very close by, as well as the bustling market in the ancient square. Free parking.
bodyContent: Enjoy a very comfortable stay at this stylish centrally-located two bedroom flat. Brought to you by 'Stay Wells and Somerset', the Guard House is a historic building within a few steps of Wells High Street with a vast array of independent shops, restaurants and cafes. The Cathedral, Vicars Close and Bishop's Palace are all just around the corner as well as a bustling twice weekly market in the ancient market square. This charming two double bedroom luxury flat takes up the entire first floor of the original 18th century Guard House in Guard House Lane and was sympathetically converted just four years ago from an impressive stone building which was originally built to house prisoners of war during the Napoleonic Wars. There is a smart entrance with entry phone system and one set of stairs up to the first floor where the main front door leads to an entrance hall with access to the lounge/kitchen/dining room which is a lovely double aspect room with rooftop views towards the Cathedral. There is engineered oak flooring fitted throughout the flat and a tasteful kitchen fitted with integrated appliances including a Stoves induction hob, oven, dishwasher, washer/dryer and fridge/freezer. There are two bedrooms with kingsize beds, one of which can be converted into a twin and a stylish shower room. There is a generous allocated parking space to the rear. High speed internet, a smart TV, an Alexa music speaker preloaded with the Unlimited Music package are also provided.

title: Camden Lodge
subtitle: A detached Georgian Lodge house in the heart of Bath of individual charm and character.
bodyContent: City centre location, 5 min. walk to the shops and restaurants. Ideal for access to all that the historic sites the city has to offer. Built around 1780, this bath stone house sits on Camden Crescent, second most famous street in Bath. This unique Lodge house is Grade II listed and situated in a beautiful part of the City Centre. A short walk away from the landmark locations of the Royal Crescent, the Circus and the High Street where you will find an abundant selection of restaurants, bars, and the shoppers’ paradise of Milsom Street. Situated in one of Bath’s most sought after locations, the Lodge has 2 bedrooms (1 double and 1 single), 1 bathroom and an open-plan kitchen. The sitting room is furnished with two sofas (one is a double sofa bed), LCD TV & DVD, and SONOS integrated sound system.

title: Stay Wells and Somerset (Grange Cottage)
subtitle: Lovely property in the heart of Somerset, sleeps 10 Bowlish Grange is a beautiful house of Jacobean origins, our large guest cottage (Grange Cottage) is available on a self catering basis. We are close to art and culture, wonderful countryside, pubs and restaurants. Visitors will love the historical setting. The cottage and garden is perfect for families.
bodyContent: Bowlish Grange is a beautiful house of Jacobean origins with a large garden for the little ones to play. We are close to art and culture, wonderful countryside, pubs and restaurants. Visitors will love the historical setting and the location. We are close to Glastonbury, Wells and the Bath and West Showground. The cottage is perfect for couples, families and business groups. We offer four double bedrooms. There are two private bathrooms each with shower and bath facilities. There is a large reception room with lovely parquet flooring, corner sofa and widescreen 4K UHD smart television with on-demand players and additional speakers. There is an impressive kitchen with granite tops and inbuilt appliances which is conveniently positioned between the indoor and outdoor dining areas. The private courtyard also offers a large BBQ and a dining area for up to 10 people. Additionally there is also a spacious decking area which is perfect for evening drinks in the sun. Ultra fast broadband is provided. The cottage is an annex of the main house with its own front door and kitchen. It is entirely self-contained. There will usually be someone around to help you throughout your stay and give you tips on the highlights of the local area including the beautiful Mendip Hills and the historic cities and towns of Bath, Wells and Glastonbury. Bowlish is a short walk from the historic town of Shepton Mallet and very close to Wells.

title: Byre Cottage
subtitle: Byre is a pleasant cottage with two bedrooms, accommodating four persons. Well furnished and fully equipped, it has ground floor level ramp access and no steps.
bodyContent: Byre Cottage is a spacious and fully equipped holiday cottage set in peaceful rural surroundings close to Bath, Bristol & Wells. Because the cottage is double glazed, has full oil fired central heating and a log fireplace it is cosy and ideal for winter breaks. The cottage has two bedrooms (One King-Size and One Twin Single) and accommodates four persons. The cottage is Mobility 1 Graded. It has ground floor level ramped access with no steps (although there is a step internally between the lounge area and the sun/dining room. Free facilities include Boules Court, Hot Tub, Sauna, Fitness Centre and Barbecue Hut, plus Video/DVD Library. Booking Byre Cottage Fully flexible short breaks are available all year round. title: Oldfields
subtitle: Oldfields is a large, elegant and traditional Victorian bed & breakfast with panoramic views of Bath.
bodyContent: Oldfields is a large, elegant and traditional Victorian bed & breakfast with panoramic views of Bath. It is superbly positioned, only 10 minutes walk to the city centre and is built from the honey-coloured stone for which Bath is famous. Although the house is equipped with every modern feature to ensure that visitors experience maximum comfort and convenience, it retains many of the elaborate cornices and artistry of its original character. The bedrooms are beautifully furnished with rich fabrics and antiques and offer a full range of amenities. You are assured of a warm welcome from the resident Managers.

title: Burys Cottage
subtitle: Burys Cottage has a cosy and romantic feel to it being tucked away in the furthest corner of the row of cottages.
bodyContent: Burys Cottage has everything you should need for a romantic getaway. The cottage has a double bedroom with ensuite bathroom. It is ideally located between Bath (5 miles) and Bradford on Avon (2 miles). The popular ‘Longleat House and Safari Drive -Through’ is 12 miles (30% off gate price tickets available for our guests when purchased online – if booked at least one week in advance). Church Farm is a working sheep farm in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. There is a luxurious indoor heated indoor pool (12m x 5m) onsite, perfect for guests whatever the weather. Burys Cottage has its own individual patio area with table, chairs and sun parasol. Farm shop and country pub/s within walking distance. Kennet and Avon Canal nearby for boating, cycling and walking. The cottage features a country feel with vaulted ceilings and exposed beams with soft furnishings to compliment. Enjoy admiring the sheep in the fields surrounding the farm. Welcome cream tea on arrival. Free Wifi.
