title: Stoberry House & Gardens
subtitle: To keep you safe during your short break, staycation or getaway, we will be offering a two or three bedroomed self catering unit comprising the Silk Room and Aeonium, or the Silk Room with Lady Hamilton and Aeonium, and the two bedroomed gatehouse cottage.
bodyContent: You will receive all the little extra touches such as dressing gowns, slippers, etc., together with a welcoming Brunch Pack on arrival. We are happy to email to you our extensive list of amenities including items you can order as extras. Click here to view the Brunch Pack Menu The Studio Suite will still be available for bed and breakfast. We have added a few novelties at a small cost, the use of a pizza oven outdoors with its ingredient pack, and a hot tub experience on certain days to enable you to relax in the rondavel with a glass of wine or champagne popped into the fridge; the views from the hot tub set within the rondavel overlooking the pond and across to the Cathedral, Glastonbury Tor and the Vale of Avalon; and the pleasure of wandering through nature in the unique gardens that Stoberry is renowned for. However, I am afraid that we do not allow under any circumstances your own beverages to be used in or around the hot tub; we are happy to email you the rules regarding the use of this facility. We will be requiring a three night minimum stay in the self catering suites and the Studio Suite. Occasional single and double nights may be offered between other bookings depending on availability. All bookings will be confirmed on a payment in advance basis and are non-refundable, except where cancellation is required as a result of Covid-19. Should you wish to cancel for any other reason, where a minimum of 7 days notice is provided, we will hold payment as credit to allow you to rearrange the stay. We are planning to fully reopen on the first of May; however, if you need to stay before, please let us know and we will take bookings complying with Government guidelines.

title: Brooks’ View
subtitle: Brooks’ View is the epitome of the favoured cottage for those seeking a special place to stay.
bodyContent: Unashamedly a luxury romantic self-catering cottage 12 minutes from Bath city centre, the cottage is ideal for weekends away, mini moons, honey moons or just a few days’ escape in the delightful countryside. Many walks for walkers and splendid for cyclists being on Sustrans Two Tunnels Route 24. Sleeping 2 in the master bedroom, recently converted Brooks’ View not only has a luxury 1400 pocket sprung bed but also a decadent bathroom with a large walk in shower and a Victorian roll top claw bath. The cosy living room has a comfortable sofa and a snuggle sofabed for that extra guest. In the winter the traditional wood burning stove provides a lovely focal point and also extra heat. There is a small dining area with a traditional pine table and 4 chairs. The kitchen is fully equipped and has both a dishwasher and a clothes washer. On those halcyon days you can easily breakfast on the patio just outside the cottage. Built in the early 1800s, Brooks’ View is one of 4 artisan cottages built for the Somerset Coal Canal workers in the tiny hamlet of Tucking Mill, in the Midford Valley, an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. An area of total peace and calm yet so close to the City. An ornithologist’s delight too..with the bird feeders attracting gold finches, coal finches, blue tits, herons and nuthatches to mention a few. Down by the brooks there is a summerhouse with a patio and a lovely stone barbecue. Ideal for enjoying that glass of cool crisp wine. Flyfishing can be arranged if you fancy a breakfast trout. AROUND AND ABOUT Lying in the historic hamlet of Tucking Mill there is plenty to interest our guests. The wildlife lovers will adore the birds and the geologists the delights of exploring the basis of the structure of the UK. this is the home of William Smith and many of his original surveys were done around this area. Bath is the most obvious attraction with the historic Abbey where Edgar the first King of England was crowned, the Roman Baths and the Thermae Spa together with the most wonderful Georgian architecture much loved by Jane Austen and her fans today. At only 20 minutes distance there is Longleat, the Saxon town of Bradford on Avon, the National Trust village of Lacock used in Jane Austen and Harry Potter films and 45 minutes drive takes you to . And there are many more…Cheddar Gorge, Wookey Hole, Bristol with the Science Museum and famous zoo. MEDIA FACILITIES There is free Wifi throughout the cottage and there is a small TV in the bedroom as well as a larger flat screen in the sitting room. An iPod Docking station is also provided. There is a selection of DVDs, a variety of books as well as some board games. PARKING Free private parking space for one car is provided and a second by arrangement REWARD CARD The benefits of the Reward Card with special discounts and extras like 3 hours for 2 in the Thermae Spa are available in this cottage. Full details in the cottage and on this website. ABOUT TUCKING MILL SELF CATERING Brooks’ View is one of the five 4 Star Luxury Gold properties in Tucking Mill Self Catering owned by Michael and Ann. There are two apartments in the city centre, The Old Smithy Loft and No 2 Hedgemead Court, and three cottages just 12 minutes drive away at Tucking Mill, Midford, a historic hamlet just outside the city boundaries in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. THOSE LOOKING AFTER YOU The property is managed by the Family Team..With Ann who has a background in hospitality and much travelling, Michael who built the barbecues and is in charge of the logs,birdfeeding and Head Housekeeper Nikki the team will do its utmost to ensure you enjoy your stay. You will also probably see Rob our invaluable man of all trades around… Short and long breaks available
tagline: Brooks’ View is the epitome of the favoured cottage for those seeking a special place to stay.

title: Broad Street House
subtitle: This listed property is spread across two floors, the open plan living and dining space works well for groups
bodyContent: Sleeps: Broad Street House is a bright and spacious maisonette in Bath’s historic centre, providing character accommodation for 12 people in four bedrooms. Bedrooms: There are four bedrooms, each with three beds. Two of the bedrooms have adult bunk beds. Bathrooms: There are two shower rooms. One on each floor next to the bedrooms. Kitchen: An open plan kitchen and dining area leads into the sitting room. General Points: This listed property is spread across two floors, the open plan living and dining space works well for groups and the location is one of the best in Bath for being in the thick of the city centre action. Parking: A parking permit for 1 vehicle (this is all we are allowed by The Council!) will be waiting at the property when you arrive. This enables you to park for free in the central area parking zone in the marked, on street parking bays. Additional long stay, Pay and Display parking is available at Manvers St and Charlotte St car parks in the city centre.

subtitle: Streamside apartment is a self catering serviced apartment set on the edge of a beautiful country park, yet only a few minutes walk from the the town centre.
bodyContent: With many leisure facilities only steps away you will easily be able to enjoy the best of the town, wonderful country walks, multi-screen cinema, bowling, the best of the towns restaurants and bars and a Nuffield health and leisure centre all on your doorstep. The one bedroom apartment sleeps 2 comfortably with a king size bed, luxury bedding and solid oak furniture. The shower room is spacious with an over sized shower, sumptuous towels, luxury toiletries and thermostatic heating. The apartment is modern and stylish, creating a relaxing ambiance, with great attention to detail. A welcome pack of breakfast essentials, fruit and a variety of Dolce Gusto hot drinks ensures you don't need to worry about stocking up. You are able to park for free outside the apartment, which is quietly located on a no through road. The owners are onsite, the apartment is a ground floor self contained annex with its own entrance, the owners live in the townhouse above, so are there should you need help or advice.

title: Penscot Inn
subtitle: All rooms are en suite with either bath or shower, fluffy white towels and organic soap and shampoo.
bodyContent: Comfortable en suite rooms with organic toiletries, free wifi, and tea/coffee with biscuits. Downstairs, enjoy a cosy bar with log fire and village green views, cider, homemade cakes, sports on TV, plus a stylish garden room overlooking the courtyard, serving great food, wine and relaxed service.

title: Bath Townhouse 8
subtitle: Bath Townhouse is a beautiful Georgian townhouse situated in the centre of Bath.
bodyContent: This townhouse is split in to two apartments; Bath Townhouse 14 and Bath Townhouse 8. They can be combined to sleep 23 or rented separately. This is a perfect location for groups of all kinds: mixed, female, male, families, wedding groups and corporate groups. The property has been lovingly restored and decorated to the highest standards in a modern vintage style which makes the most of the many original features, including the cornicing, Georgian fireplaces, original shutters , beautifully restored Georgian windows and original vault area. Both apartments are fully equipped for a self catering holiday break, with fully fitted kitchens, wide screen TVS, free WIFI and top quality bedding and towels. Bath Townhouse 8 has 3 spacious bedrooms, 3 beautifully presented wet rooms/bathrooms, a comfortable lounge with modular, colourful seating, modern lighting, fully fitted kitchen with table and chairs for 9 people. The lower ground floor has a additional entertainment area in the vaults, a great area if the ‘kids’ want their own space! Bars, restaurants, shops, and all Bath’s many interesting tourist sites are right outside the front door! The Roman Baths and Thermae Bath Spa are just a stones throw away. Bath Spa Train Station and Coach station are 5 minutes walk. Whether you are in Bath to watch Bath Rugby play at home at the famous Recreation Ground, visit your son or daughter at Bath University, have a little retail therapy in the great independent shops or enjoy the many festivals that take place in Bath then this is the perfect property for you and your group!
tagline: Bath Townhouse is a beautiful Georgian townhouse

title: The Cabin North Down Farm
subtitle: Brand new for 2023! The Cabin at North Down Farm is an idyllic retreat that is as stunning on the inside as it is on the outside. With outstanding views from your own decking this cool cabin for two is the ideal spot for an escape to the country.
bodyContent: Step inside and you'll discover luxury interiors inspired by the colours of the Somerset countryside, cosy wood burner, sumptuous sofa and gorgeous wrought iron king-size bed. This welcoming cabin is a lovely space with, comfy green velvet sofa, countryside views and a Smart TV, there's also a Roberts digital radio with Bluetooth. For non-electrical entertainment, there's some good old-fashioned board games, playing cards and a number of books. The fully functioning kitchen with beautiful wooden worktop and hand made taps includes an Everhot stove, providing not only heating but multi tasking as an oven. Sleeping two, there is a king-size wrought iron bed with luxury British made pocket sprung mattress filled with all natural fibers and White Company linens, cloud soft bedding and stylish cushions. Outside you have full use of your own decking with the most stunning views down a private valley to the Quantock hills in the distance, the perfect spot for a morning coffee or evening drinks. Set on the edge of Exmoor just outside of Wiveliscombe this is the perfect location for a wonderful escape. A huge draw for walkers and cyclists Exmoor and the Quantocks are in easy reach and the North Somerset coast just 25 minutes away. Set on the edge of the designated 'Dark Skies Area' The Cabin is the perfect place to star gaze as an expert astronomer or just appreciate the spectacular night sky. We welcome all our guests with a basket filled with local produce.
tagline: Brand new for 2023! The Cabin at North Down Farm

title: The Design Studio
subtitle: Newly converted and elegantly furnished in a comfortable and contemporary style by two local artists Jean and Martin Farrell, the chic apartment boasts a spacious bedroom and living area which leads through to a kitchen and dining area.
bodyContent: Built in the basement of a pretty family house, the flat has its own entrance via the front garden with full height french windows allowing in plenty of natural light. With a plush super king size zip and link bed, and a fold out sofa bed, the apartment can sleep three people and is perfect for couples and small groups of friends. There is a smart TV, radio and a selection of games and books so the apartment is a great place to relax after a day of sightseeing. The kitchen contains the basics needed to prepare, serve and enjoy a simple meal for three, with a microwave and coffee machine as well as utensils and tableware. Apartment also has underfloor heating throughout the flat. A large shower, loo, mirror and sink can all be found in the bathroom. Free WiFi is available through the flat.

title: Barleycorn
subtitle: Located in a picturesque rural setting, Barleycorn is a beautiful cottage for two people.
bodyContent: Sleep in a king sized bed with 100% cotton bedlinen and enjoy the luxury of underfloor heating throughout. Take a country walk from your cottage, visit the historic city of Bath or just enjoy the stunning views from the farm. Just twenty minutes drive from the City of Bath, Barleycorn is a beautifully converted old milking parlour suitable for two people sharing. Barleycorn is an excellent location for a romantic holiday within easy reach of Bath, Bristol or Wells. Withy MillsFarm is a set in a stunning rural setting and combines the peacefulness of the countryside with the closeness of three wonderful cities to explore. The open plan kitchen/living room has a fitted kitchen, oak dining table, settees and TV. It also has a large walk in shower room and in the bedroom a king sized bed with 100% cotton bed linen. You can also enjoy the luxury of underfloor heating throughout the cottage. Prices are inclusive of electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, cotton bed linen, large and small white towels. There is parking outside your door for up to two vehicles. Start your holiday with a home made cream tea on arrival, then plan the activities for your stay. There are numerous footpaths leading from the cottage. A useful guide book in Barleycorn suggests many of the best local walks. Withy Mills Farm is a working dairy farm, but the main business of the farm is carried out at another location. This means you will not be disturbed by any tractors early in the morning. Unfortunately we are unable to accept dogs at Withy Mills Farm.
tagline: Barleycorn is a beautiful cottage for two people.

title: Pulteney Guest House Bed and Breakfast
subtitle: Pulteney House Bed and Breakfast is a large, elegant Victorian house set in its own picturesque west facing gardens, with fine views of Bath Abbey only 10 minutes’ level walk from the centre of Bath.
bodyContent: Pulteney House Bed and Breakfast is a large, elegant Victorian house set in its own picturesque west facing gardens, with fine views of Bath Abbey only 10 minutes’ level walk from the centre of Bath. The Bed and Breakfast has 16 rooms with en-suite facilities, and 1 with private facilities that are opposite the room. We offer a range of room types including family rooms, single rooms, double and twin rooms. A limited number are ground floor rooms. Pulteney House has been privately owned since 1979 and we provide a warm homely welcome to all guests. The large mature gardens are always kept in beautiful condition and guests are encouraged to utilise them where children can play in absolute safety. A comfortable family TV lounge is available for guests to use and relax in away from their room. Private onsite car park with CCTV for added security and peace of mind. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms and public areas. Free use of computer for those guests with no personal device. A large and varied Breakfast menu is available and we cater for a range of specific dietary requirements.
tagline: Pulteney House Bed and Breakfast is a large, elegant Victorian house

title: The Georgian Manor
subtitle: A striking boutique-style apartment within a grand Georgian manor house, this homestay has the feel of a luxury country hotel, but with the freedom of your own private bolthole in town.
bodyContent: The Georgian Manor is perfectly situated to give you the best of both worlds: it’s located just a pleasant ten minute walk from the vibrant town centre of Frome, and a short drive from scenic Somerset rambles and inspiring cultural attractions. The ideal decadent retreat for a cultural break or romantic getaway. The apartment is a glorious mix of old and new styles, decorated throughout with distinctive statement artwork and ornaments, while retaining the grand magnificence of the eighteenth century building. The original window shutters, cast iron radiators and ornate plasterwork echo the history of the property, while touches of modern luxury such as chandeliers, ornate mirrors and a roll top bath lend an air of opulent decadence. Enter the Georgian Manor through the grand entrance hall, or direct from your private parking area to the rear. The apartment is laid out on one level with a spacious open plan living area, which is bathed in natural light thanks to the double-aspect floor to ceiling sash windows and balcony doors. A particular highlight of the Georgian Manor is the ornate wrought iron balcony, accessed through the patio doors beyond the seating area. The balcony overlooks the communal garden area, and is the perfect place to savour a croissant and coffee for breakfast, or a Somerset sunset at dusk. A compact and well-equipped kitchen to your right boasts an integrated breakfast bar, cooker and washing machine. Chat to your friends or partner relaxing on the leather sofas while you rustle up a Frome feast of local produce. Beyond the kitchen area you will find a classically decorated bathroom, complete with Grecian-style floor tiles and a sumptuous roll top bath. And then finally, the bedroom awaits at the front of the house. After a restorative night’s sleep on the kingsize bed, in Egyptian cotton sheets on a luxurious Vispring mattress , you will wake to a room bathed in glorious sunshine from the grand sash windows. A stay at the Georgian Manor leaves you feeling relaxed and pampered by boutique-style luxury in a homely setting.

title: Avondale Riverside
subtitle: Avondale Riverside Apartments standing in it’s own south facing garden with balconied views over the River Avon , it’s wildlife nature reserve and meadows against the back drop of Georgian Bath.
bodyContent: Autumn bookings now available with special cleaning measures in place. The safety and enjoyment of our guests a priority. Weather is looking better too! Some Oct dates still available. Flexible stays with full refunds for cancellations. Present regulations restrict numbers to six people only. Bath 5 * Avondale Riverside Apartments standing in it’s own south facing garden with balconied views over the River Avon , it’s wildlife nature reserve and meadows against the back drop of Georgian Bath. Good local amenities in the village of Batheaston and regular bus service into the City Centre. Boat trips into the City from the village of Bathampton. Accommodation in one large apartment sleeping 8- 10. Well equipped and comfortably furnished the ideal base for exploring Bath, the Cotswolds and surrounding area or just relaxing with a g & t on the balcony watching the sunset after a soak in the Hot Tub. Celebrate that special Birthday, Anniversary at Avondale with a private dinner party & your own Chef. Pets are very welcome with a few doggie rules. We supply safety gates for toddlers and furry visitors. There is a wide screen TV in the lounge with dvd player & library, there is also a music system with ipod dock. Parking is in a secure forecourt with an automated gate system. Mid week discounts out of season.
tagline: Avondale Riverside Apartments standing in it’s own south facing garden

title: The Halcyon Apartments
subtitle: The Halcyon Apartments are for guests who like to have their cake and eat it. Located in the heart of Bath next to our sister property, The Porter, these luxury apartments are more than just a plush pied-a-terre.
bodyContent: We've blended the hospitality and comfort of The Halcyon with all the trappings of The Porter. As a guest here you get the best of both worlds: the space and privacy of your own city pad with the kind of hotel services you wish you had at home. Beautifully designed to reflect their Georgian heritage, our spacious apartments have elegant high ceilings, large sash windows and a neutral decor furnished with statement pieces that makes for a laid-back, sophisticated vibe. Dine out, dine in, hit the shops, take in the sights or just lounge like a local. Our apartments have everything you'll need for a perfect stay. The Halcyon boutique hotel apartments in Bath are your launch pad to Bath city centre. Ideal Bath accommodation for spa breaks, self catering holidays, visiting Bath Abbey, the Roman Baths, Pulteney Bridge, Jane Austen museum and all the other major attractions in Bath. title: Anvil Cottage
subtitle: Anvil Cottage is a beautiful 5 Star Gold holiday cottage, sleeping 4, set in the grounds of The Close, an 18th century house facing the duck pond, in Biddestone.
bodyContent: Anvil Cottage is a beautiful 5 Star Gold holiday cottage, sleeping 4, set in the grounds of The Close, an 18th century house facing the duck pond, on the village green, in Biddestone. It is ideally placed to visit the World Heritage City of Bath, and to explore the historic villages and countryside of Wiltshire and the Cotswolds. Originally a working forge supplying agricultural implements and tools, Anvil Cottage has recently undergone sympathetic restoration to create a high class holiday home, whilst retaining many original features. The main living area is a magnificent open space created from the original forge, measuring approx. 28ft x 21ft. The property provides flexible accommodation on one level, including one double bedroom and a second bedroom with a double bed which can be converted to two singles – ideal for families with younger children. There are 2 steps down from the living area to the bedrooms and bathrooms. The property is tastefully furnished, with all necessary facilities and amenities. Occupants have their own gravelled seating area to the rear of the property, and are welcome to use the orchard and paddock of The Close. The property is available for weekly rental from Friday to Friday, with long weekends and mid week breaks by special request.
tagline: Anvil Cottage is a beautiful 5 Star Gold holiday cottage

bodyContent: The Langbury is 100 metres from the beach and Blue Anchor Station where you can board a steam train on the West Somerset Railway – the longest preserved railway in the country. subtitle: Hedgemead Court is our luxury, family-owned 2 bedroom apartment in Bath city centre.
bodyContent: Hedgemead Court is Ann and Michael ‘s newly-renovated Bath city centre apartment. You can visit Bath’s best attractions within a few minutes’ walk as the apartment is just a stone’s throw from Walcot Street artisan quarter and the Bath Abbey. Furthermore, from the ground floor balcony you have views across the adjacent 5-acre Hedgemead Park and down Walcot Street. Inside the apartment the interior is light, spacious and modern. 2 Hedgemead Court is easy to reach with on-site private parking directly outside; a rarity in Bath city centre! You’ll stay at the top of Walcot Street’s artisan quarter, which is full of vibrant independent shops, only a stroll from Bath Abbey and numerous restaurants. Most of all our holiday let is a great alternative to hotels for those wanting a space of their own, on business or for pleasure.

title: The Malthouse
subtitle: Fall in love with The Malthouse, a romantic Grade II listed building with modern levels of space and comfort, perfectly located for family holidays in Somerset. 7 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, modern kitchen, with open fire, two large living areas, reliable wi-fi and idyllic views over the garden and private parking.
bodyContent: As soon as you walk through the heavy oak door into the original cart-way, you feel this warm friendly space, from the cart-way you will see the stylish handmade kitchen and dining room, complete with working stone fireplace. The huge pine dining table is just asking to host up to 14 people for an extended family meal or several breakfast sittings, cooked up in the well-equipped kitchen. A utility room in the basement has a washing machine, tumble drier and extra tall fridge plus a useful storage area for extra food. The two lounges are comfortable and thoughtfully furnished. One has an inglenook fireplace, very welcoming on those colder days, deep sofa, workspace and cosy lighting. The other is the garden room where you can enjoy far-reaching views of the idyllic countryside. Elegantly proportioned and plenty of room for family games, relaxation and 50inch smart TV. The 7 bedrooms are large and comfortable with crisp Egyptian cotton linen and fluffy towels. One king bedroom on the ground floor with its own bathroom, 1st and second floor a further 6 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Decorated with style and comfort in mind. There's a big open courtyard and large, long, well-managed garden. Guests enjoy alfresco dining and barbecues. A range of outdoor games including table tennis are provided for screen-free fun, well behaved dogs welcome. Private parking. On your doorstep Bath, Bristol, Longleat all easily reached, as well as many local walks and National Trust gardens.

title: Tilbury Farm
subtitle: Stay in the Quantock Hills - a designated area of outstanding natural beauty in West Somerset
bodyContent: Nestled in a fold of the beautiful Quantock Hills and enjoying breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding countryside, eighteenth century Tilbury Farm offers a wonderful choice of varied luxury self-catering accommodation. Make your choice from a converted sandstone barn a cosy shepherd’s hut on your own private hillside meadow from which to enjoy sunset views towards Exmoor or, for larger groups and family holidays, the sixteenth century thatched cottage sleeping eleven may be more suitable. Whichever accommodation you choose, peace, tranquility and relaxation are put to the top of the the agenda from the moment you arrive. Connecting to wildlife is proven to benefit our own health and wellbeing and all Tilbury Farm holiday accommodation provides opportunities to get closer to nature, with red deer, buzzards, bats and owls all regular visitors to the site. You can also befriend the Farm’s Exmoor Horn flock, ponies and rare breed pigs. Walk, cycle and ride over a network of footpaths and bridle-paths across the Quantock Hills, where the famous poets Coleridge and Wordsworth once lived, walked and wrote.

title: Toll Keepers House
subtitle: Built into the side of Bath’s historic Cleveland Bridge, looking out over the River Avon, this Regency property offers guests a truly unique experience.
bodyContent: Originally a toll house, dating from 1827, the two-bedroom city centre property is built over three floors. The interior has been beautifully refurbished to provide comfort and convenience while preserving its traditional charm. The house has a garden sloping down to the water’s edge which boasts a terrace and summerhouse perfect for al fresco meals or evening drinks. The ground-floor kitchen dining room’s large French windows open out onto the terrace creating a feeling of light and space. The fully equipped kitchen includes an induction hob, microwave, fan oven, dishwasher and washer-drier, with a dining table and dining sets for up to six people. Above the kitchen is the master-bedroom with a super-king size bed that can be split into two twins and ensuite bathroom. Next door is a second bedroom with double bed. On the third floor is a cosy living room with a 42-inch TV and an extra wall double bed which can be laid out to accommodate two more guests. A second shared bathroom with a shower can also be found here. Wifi is available throughout the house. Parking: Parking permit for 1 car.

title: Tourism Sector in the South West Faces New Challenges and Opportunities, landmark new tourism report finds
subtitle: The findings come from the first in-depth Tourism Trends Annual Report, published by the South West Visitor Economy Hub (SWVEH). The 145-page report provides exclusive insights into visitor behaviour, accommodation performance, and spending across the region in 2024.

title: Spreyton Guest House
subtitle: A warm welcome awaits visitors to Spreyton Guest House, in Weston Super Mare.
bodyContent: Spreyton Guest House offers warm, family-run accommodation in a Victorian house in Weston-super-Mare, just a 10-minute walk from the train station, town centre and seafront. Nearby attractions include the Grand Pier, Odeon Cinema, Playhouse Theatre, Winter Gardens and Sealife Centre. Off-street parking available; 24-7 online booking.
tagline: A warm welcome awaits visitors to Spreyton Guest House, in Weston Super Mare.

title: Walnut Barn Estates
subtitle: Luxury Cottages & Unique Glamping set on 50-Acre Farm in AONB. Ideal for groups or Romantic Secluded getaways.
bodyContent: Perfect for Family or Romantic breaks & bring your dog. Set in the foothills of the Mendips with Woodland Walks on doorstep & dog friendly beaches not far away. Local Pub just 5 mins walk. Enjoy the Farm Fresh Eggs daily and take in the fresh Somerset Country air. Most with Hot Tubs. Ideal for guests wanting either a traditional Cosy Country Cottage or a Back to Nature feel with our Glamping experience. The Quaint Shepherds Hut or our Quirky Yurt both with their Hot Tubs set the scene for total relaxation. Walnut Barns is set in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty with miles of woodland walks on its doorstep. A real sense of seclusion, back to nature and perfect for that Digital Detox. The dog friendly beaches just a few minutes’ drive away. Pull your boots on and explore the South West Coast Path, Exmoor or if its culture you’re after hop on the train & visit Bristol or Bath. The Old Dairy is perfect for Groups and Family reunions- sleeps 12 with huge Hot Tub & massive garden all enclosed. The Cider Barn is a cosy cottage sleeps 3 with own Orchard & log burner. Try Glamping and stay at our Romantic getaways - Lady’s Well is our Unique Shepherds Hut, own grounds with Hot Tub, pond & Koi Carp. Meditation Viewing Platform with fabulous views of the sunsets over the bay. Orchard View Yurt is Luxury Glamping at its best with Hot Tub, Fire pit & private enclosed garden. Hop aboard our Electric Golf Buggy and we will transport you and your luggage to your chosen Haven. However, don’t forget to bring your wellies. The emphasis is on privacy and comfort and the owners have ensured that each property fulfils this. The farm dates back to the Doomsday book and is a Site of Special Scientific Interest & was once part of the Hutton Court Estate. So don’t hesitate and join us for the Somerset experience. There is always something going on Wassailing in January, Lambing in spring , Hay making & Apple picking. Not forgetting our Poultry Orchard where the Rheas (Emus), Geese, Ducks & Hens never fail as a source of amusement. The children love it….

title: Supporting the Energy Transition and Power Generation in the South West
subtitle: As we look towards 2050 and the UK's longer-term ambitions around reducing our carbon footprint and greenhouse emissions, Colleges in the region are stepping up to the challenge by preparing their students for the careers that will be plentiful around green energy and power supply.

title: St Anne's B&B
subtitle: Experience an atmosphere of peace and inspiration - idyllic setting on the slopes of Chalice Hill.
bodyContent: Four individually styled en-suite bedrooms, two doubles & one twin. Full breakfast, vegetarian, all diets catered for. In-house therapies. Use of garden room, car parking & internet. Very warm welcome, a personal touch. Close to town centre, Tor & Chalice Well.
tagline: Experience an atmosphere of peace and inspiration - idyllic setting on the slopes of Chalice Hill.

title: Warrens Farm Holidays – The Croft at Warrens Farm
subtitle: A country cottage all on one level based on a farm within a mile of the Devon/Somerset border . The Croft has two bedrooms, large open plan living area with log burner and garden. Country walks from your doorstep. Easy reach of Taunton, Honiton, the East Devon Coast and beyond.
bodyContent: A country cottage all on one level based on a farm within a mile of the Devon/Somerset border . The Croft has two bedrooms, large open plan living area with log burner and garden. Country walks from your doorstep. Easy reach of Taunton, Honiton, the East Devon Coast and beyond. A dog friendly country cottage based in the Blackdown Hills AONB, near the Somerset/Devon border with wood burning stove. The Croft sleeps 4 in two bedrooms with a large open plan kitchen/dining/living room. There is an excellent local pub (The York Inn, Churchinford) within walking distance and lots more country pubs within a short drive. Otterhead Lakes local Nature Reserve can be accessed within a couple of minutes walk. The cottage is within easy reach of Taunton, Honiton, Exeter, the East Devon Coast and beyond, providing a great base to explore the surrounding area. Our cottage is all on one level, so perfect for the less able (two small steps into front door). Parking adjacent to cottage on private drive. *Open plan living area *Well equipped kitchen, with coffee machine & dishwasher. *Cosy living area with wood burning stove and smart TV. *Master bedroom with king size bed and TV *Second bedroom with two single beds *Bathroom with large walk-in shower (no bath). *Courtyard garden with garden furniture and BBQ *Excellent local pub within walking distance (1 mile) *Local walks to include Otterhead Local Nature Reserve, Castle Neroche, Wellington Monument, Ham Hill & Staple Hill *Local attractions include Flip Out Somerset, The Museum of Somerset, Vivary Adventure Centre, Somerset County Cricket Ground, Hestercombe House, Wildwood Escot, Burrow Farm Gardens, Axe Valley Wildlife Park & The Donkey Sanctuary to name a few

title: Stay at Penny's Mill
subtitle: Luxury Bed & Breakfast in Nunney, Somerset
bodyContent: Our lovely 200-year old watermill, set in the charming Somerset village of Nunney, is the ideal centre for a West Country break – close to Bath, Frome, Longleat, Stourhead, The Newt in Somerset, Hauser & Wirth and Babington House. We offer you our hospitality, the freedom of our beautiful house – and the chance to enjoy Rosie’s famous breakfasts! Most of all, we will do our level best to give you a relaxed, informal, comfortable stay in our people-friendly Bed & Breakfast – one of Somerset’s most special places to stay. Each of our three spacious rooms at Penny’s Mill provides comforts such as crisp white cotton bedlinen, down pillows and duvets (with man-made alternatives available), large towels, free wireless broadband & flat screen TVs

title: Watermeadow Lakes & Lodges
subtitle: Watermeadow Lakes and Lodges offer the choice of three luxury lakeside lodges Willow, Heron and Kingfisher for self-catering holiday.
bodyContent: Lettings for upto 4 with pets welcome and all set in beautiful and peaceful surroundings alongside our course fishing lake and of course your own private hot tub on the veranda overlooking the wildlife. We now have two luxury Romantic Escape Lodges Bluebell and Foxglove, designed for couples only to relax in a unique lodge with your own private hot-tub !! Sorry we don't accept pets in these but you will have the most amazing experience with the one you love, we promise !!

title: Steps Farmhouse
subtitle: Steps Farmhouse is a 16th Century former farmhouse in the Hamlet of Bilbrook, ideal for walkers and cyclists.
bodyContent: Steps Farmhouse is a 16th Century former farmhouse in the Hamlet of Bilbrook, ideal for walkers and cyclists. We offer bed and breakfast accommodation in comfortable centrally heated bedrooms, in barn conversions located in beautiful secluded gardens with views towards the Brendon Hills and Exmoor . All bedrooms have en-suite facilities, remote controlled TV, clock/radio alarms, and a hospitality tray with a selection of teas, coffee & biscuits. Breakfasts are served in the main house in our cosy dining room with oak beams and inglenook fireplace. Packed lunches are available on request. Enjoy the charm of West Somerset and it's varied attractions. Take a trip back in time on the West Somerset Steam Railway or for the walking and cycling enthusiast, Exmoor and the surrounding hills have an abundance of footpaths and bridal ways. Books & detailed maps of Exmoor and the Quantocks are availble to borrow.
tagline: Steps Farmhouse is a 16th Century former farmhouse in the Hamlet of Bilbrook, ideal for walkers

title: Webbington Farm Holiday Cottages
subtitle: Self catering accommodation in Somerset nestled below Crooks Peak (SSSI & AONB) on the edge of the Somerset Mendips Hills. Thirty minutes from the M5 Junction 22 and 40 minutes from Bristol Airport.
bodyContent: Self catering accommodation in Somerset nestled below Crooks Peak (SSSI & AONB) on the edge of the Somerset Mendips Hills and amidst Somerset's famous cider making and Cheddar strawberry growing area, the cottages are commutable to most of Somerset's amazing attractions between Cheddar & Weston-super-Mare. Stay on a working beef farm in luxury! We offer beautiful bespoke holidays for families, couples and groups, so please call us at anytime for your personally tailored holiday. You may want the hot tub, party barn, catering, tranquility, the farmhouse, one cottage or all four. Its up to you so do call. Nestled below Crooks Peak (SSSI & AONB) on the edge of the Somerset Mendips Hills and amidst Somerset's famous cider making and Cheddar strawberry growing area, the cottages are commutable to most of Somerset's amazing attractions. The 4 fantastic oak beamed cottages comprise: KITTY accommodates 4 adults & 1 baby in 2 bedrooms (1 double bed & 2 singles) with family bathroom and open plan lounge/kitchen/diner downstairs with patio to the front of the cottage. GOLIGHTLY accommodates 7 adults & 1 baby in 3 bedrooms - 1 triple (double & single), 1 twin & 1 bunk bed room, with family bathroom and open plan lounge/diner & separate kitchen downstairs with patio to the front of the cottage. TIARKS accommodates 7 adults & 1 baby in 2 bedrooms (1 double, 1 triple & 1 double sofa bed in the lounge). This cottage has the benefit of being on one level and is therefore suitable for the elderly/less mobile & has its own private patio to the rear of this cottage and private luxury hot tub room! The hot tub room is available to guests who book Tiarks individually OR as part of a larger booking. POPPY accommodates 7 adults & 1 baby in 3 bedrooms one double ensuite, one triple (double & single) and one twin with family bathroom, and large open plan lounge/kitchen/diner downstairs with patio to the front of the cottage. Each cottage has full central heating throughout. The kitchens are fully equipped with a dishwasher, washer/dryer, fridge/freezer, electric oven/hob and microwave. The lounges/dining areas have leather suites, wide screen Smart TV and Wifi. The bathroom has a "P" bath/shower, shaver point, toilet, hand basin and heated towel rail. Directly outside the properties is a large patio area equipped with individual outdoor furniture. The large, communal and enclosed gardens and children's activity play area are located across the courtyard. Car parking also available. Self Catering Rates: All inclusive of all power, bed linen and towels (not swimming or hot tub), along with Spa day pass (indoor pool, sauna, steam room, tennis courts and gym) and a Somerset goodies welcome pack. THE RUSTIC PARTY BARN - available for hire with self catering accommodation for larger groups comprising bar, seating for 30, wood burner, sound system and room to party the night away. If you don't fancy having to organise the catering we can help! FARMHOUSE accommodation is located opposite the holiday lets which is rented out on a room only basis & accommodates 5 adults & one baby in a triple shower ensuite and an interconnecting twin bedroom. Note: if both rooms are booked the modern family bathroom opposite is also included. As a family farm there is opportunity to see the animals and experience at close hand 'life on the farm'. We are very keen on the environment and have planted 10,000 trees into a woodland, replanted an apple orchard and are involved in a number of schemes promoting good environmental practice, including a reed bed. We also have our own river frontage on the River Axe for private fishing! ***PLEASE CONTACT 07900 273722 TO BOOK FRIDAY TO MONDAY STAYS*** ***USE THE BOOK DIRECT BUTTON TO BOOK MONDAY TO THURSDAY STAYS*** Or call direct to have a chat and book direct. Bespoke 2/3 night Short Breaks & Farmhouse accommodation - on request.
tagline: Self catering accommodation in Somerset nestled below Crooks Peak

title: Summerhouse B&B
subtitle: We will welcome you to this relaxed and luxurious rural retreat with its magnificent views across the Chew Valley to the foothills of the Mendips. This is truly somewhere to unwind after a day out exploring the beautiful Somerset countryside or the architectutral glory of Bath or Wells.
bodyContent: We will welcome you to this relaxed and luxurious rural retreat with its magnificent views across the Chew Valley to the foothills of the Mendips . This is truly somewhere to unwind after a day out exploring the beautiful Somerset countryside or the architectutral glory of Bath or Wells . When you arrive, you can enjoy homemade cake in your room with a pot of tea ot cafetiere of coffee, watch buzzards circling over the valley or the green woodpeckers in the garden, chill out in our Summerhouse or take a dip in our luxurious indoor pool. You may wish to plan your stay using our books and maps. In the evening, just sit and enjoy watching deer munching on our home grown vegetables. Centrally situated for visiting Bath, Wells, Bristol, Cheddar Gorge and the Mendip Hills, our B&B is ideal for exploring this beautiful area. There are several walks from the house, including a stiff climb up to the Iron Age Hill fort atop Norton Malreward or a meander down from the footpath at the end of our drive along the Chew Valley to see the Stanton Drew Standing Stones. We have three rooms at our B&B; they have been individually designed to ensure that you have a very relaxing and comfortable stay. Our cosy bedrooms reflect the tranquil atmosphere and character of our home. Residents at our B&B have free acess to the spa, you will have exclusive use of the swimming pool, jacuzzi, steam shower, water rower, changing rooms, and two robes and towels also a pair of slippers. Booking is required.

title: Wembdon Farm
subtitle: Welcome to Wembdon Farm offering Self-catering Accommodation in two Cottages, near the historic town of Bridgwater, Somerset.
bodyContent: We are situated in the rural countryside but not far from Bridgwater and its amenities and shops. We are also centre of the county of Somerset and all that it has to offer making it all accessible. Our Self-catering Accommodation at Wembdon Farm Cottages . . . Self-catering accommodation is offered in 2 Cottages, both with 2 en-suite bedrooms, kitchen and lounge diner and can accommodate 4 people in each cottage. Wembdon Farm Self Catering Cottages are situated on the edge of Wembdon, a small rural village on the outskirts of Bridgwater. There is only a mere two miles from our site to the centre of the historic market town of Bridgwater in Somerset, which provides you with all the necessary amenities. Bakers and Dairy Cottage are two luxury holiday cottages, which were converted from farm buildings in 2001 to produce outstanding ground floor accommodation that enables disability access. Each cottage consists of two en-suite bedrooms for your comfort and convenience, with ample private parking for your transportation. The working family farm comprises of around 320 acres of land, which is largely used for arable activities. The rest of the land is used for beef production and environmental management. Escape and enjoy yourselves at these Luxury Self Catering Farm Cottages, fully equipped to a very high standard, surrounded by patchwork fields and footpaths. A convenient retreat, central for all that Somerset has to offer, with the Quantock Hills and South-West coast nearby. So book now to visit the place where great memories are made.

title: Tarr Farm Inn
subtitle: Tarr Farm is a beautiful inn dating from the 1600s based in the heart of the Exmoor National Park right by the historic Tarr Steps on the River Barle.
bodyContent: We’ve won numerous awards for our fantastic food. You can book a table in our cosy bar and feast on our hearty bar menu or enjoy our more formal restaurant with a full a la carte menu. If the weather is good, we have tables outside in our garden which overlooks Tarr Steps. Round it off with a stay in one of our comfortable rooms and take a seat for one of our delicious breakfasts in the morning. We are family friendly and also welcome your four legged friends too. Relax in Beautiful Surroundings Each of the nine rooms at Tarr Farm Inn has been designed to provide every modern comfort. Fresh and contemporary, the bedrooms and bathrooms are generously proportioned and little luxuries such as organic bath products, power showers and full size baths, the fluffiest bathrobes and towels and Egyptian cotton sheets are included. Our Rooms Television, DVD players and iPod docking station with a radio allow you to really relax, while a pull-out desk, wi-fi broadband access and direct dial telephone makes working convenient. You’ll find all the facilities you’d expect – iron and ironing board, mini bar and tea and coffee making with fresh milk – plus some you might not, like the homemade biscuits, personal safes and basket of essentials you may have forgotten.

title: West Hollowcombe Cottages
subtitle: Self catering cottages in Exmoor National Park, Somerset near Dulverton. Dog friendly. Children's play area, 60 acres.
bodyContent: Our self-catering cottages are both spacious and well appointed. Located in the glorious surroundings of Exmoor National Park . We offer absolute peace and quiet. However, with good luck and a following wind, we are only a three hour drive away from either London or Birmingham. The Two Moors Way passes our gate and for the energetic, numerous other walks, accessible directly from the cottages, can be explored. Dogs and horses are also welcome; with a DIY livery basis. Alternatively you may simply decide to chill out and enjoy the magnificent views and wildlife. We are within easy reach of the coastal towns of Porlock, Lynton and Lynmouth and close to Lorna Doone country. The pretty town of Dulverton is only a short drive away for shopping and browsing the art galleries. There is a purpose built playground in front of the cottages as well as a selection of ride-on toys. As a family run business, we guarantee you a warm welcome in any one of our four cottages. Explore our sixty acres of fields and woodlands. Let Exmoor work its magic: take a weekend break from the hustle and bustle or come and stay for a week or two. Short breaks of 3 nights available at certain times of year. Do call to discuss.
tagline: Self catering cottages in Exmoor National Park, Somerset near Dulverton.

title: The Ayrlington
subtitle: Built of golden Bath stone in 1874 by the architect J Elkinton Gill, the award-winning Ayrlington is a handsome listed Victorian house with exceptional views of the City and its medieval Abbey.
bodyContent: Built of golden Bath stone in 1874 by the architect J Elkinton Gill, the award-winning Ayrlington is a handsome listed Victorian house with exceptional views of the City and its medieval Abbey. Bath’s magnificent historic sites, speciality shops and excellent restaurants are all just a 5-10 minute level stroll away. The elegant and tranquil interior is a graceful blend of English and Asian antiques, artwork, fine fabrics and Egyptian cotton bedlinen – all 19 bedrooms have individual themes and are beautifully furnished, some with four-poster beds. We also offer a residents’ bar, secure private parking and is entirely non smoking. We do not accept children under 5 years of age. The Ayrlington was the proud recipient of a Silver-Gilt certificate at the 2014 Bath In Bloom awards.
tagline: Built of golden Bath stone in 1874 by the architect J Elkinton Gill

title: The Beeches Holiday Homes
subtitle: The Beeches holiday homes are 2 separate properties, the west wing of a C18th character house.
bodyContent: They have been recently renovated, are spacious and completely self-contained. Lower Beeches welcomes up to 5 people, Upper Beeches up to 7; you can book separately or together. Lower Beeches is a beautiful cottage; oak floors, marble worktop, bespoke woodwork, original art-work. With 2 spacious bedrooms, a ground floor kingsize and a twin room on the 1st floor. The 5th bed is a guest bed with mattress topper which can be placed either room. Both bedrooms have TV, en-suite shower-room & garden views. There is exclusive use of a south-facing garden, patio, bbq. Good for couples or families, young or old. Upper Beeches is especially good for families with older children or groups of friends. It has a welcoming, spacious and contemporary interior. It is best for up to 6 people, but can stretch to 7. It has 2/ 3 bedrooms over 2 floors. A family size bathroom with dual-head shower over the bath and an en-suite on the second floor. Beautiful outdoor space with views. Both properties have smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, Blue-tooth, parking for 2 cars. They are child-friendly. Small/medium dogs welcome. Private access to 25 acres with lakes and an C18th grotto to explore. A generous welcome pack with filter coffee, a range of teas, home-made bread, biscuits and milk, eggs and butter from a local farm. Fabulous location: Oakhill is a pretty village with two pubs, both with great food. Wonderful woodland walks from the door. It offers easy access to Glastonbury, Longleat, Cheddar & Ebbor Gorge, Mendip Hills; or Somerset Levels for murmurations & wildlife. There are 3 cities nearby. Drive 12 mins to medieval Wells with magnificent cathedral, palace & ‘Dragons Lair' for under-12's. Under 30 mins to gorgeous Bath, spa and Chrismas market. Just 40 mins to vibrant Bristol; street art, 3-D planetarium, fantastic theatres, Hauser & Wirth, Kilver Court.

title: Wills Barn
subtitle: Nestled in the heart of the Mendips, Wills Barn is the perfect place to get away from and enjoy some quiet time in the country. Unwind, fire up the log burner and take in the panoramic views of Blagdon Lake, Chew Valley and beyond. Countryside breaks just don’t come cosier.
bodyContent: Nestled in the heart of the Mendips, Wills Barn is the perfect place to get away from it all and enjoy some quiet time in the country. Unwind and destress at this secluded upside-down barn, taking in the panoramic views of Blagdon Lake, Chew Valley and beyond. With its log fire, film projector and amphitheatre fire pit (don’t forget the marshmallows!), countryside breaks just don’t come cosier. Will’s Barn is a 250 year old limestone building that was renovated in 2020 using as much low-impact, sustainable and recycled material as we could get our hands on! Remember to bring your wellies or walking boots as the area is packed with hiking routes, including the new Yeo Valley Way – we’ve got plenty of walking books for you to peruse and follow! Well behaved dogs are welcome but there may be livestock in the surrounding fields so please bring a lead.

title: Wookey Hole Mendip View Luxury Lodges
subtitle: Revamped, restored and totally remarkable, the new Wookey Hole experience has burst onto the holiday scene in an explosive mix of history, fun and mystery.
bodyContent: Revamped, restored and totally remarkable, the new Wookey Hole experience has burst onto the holiday scene in an explosive mix of history, fun and mystery. New for 2016 - why not stay in their luxury holiday lodges from £250.00 for a three night stay. Wookey Hole and Mendip View are 2 miles from the medieval city of Wells , and 20 miles from Bath and Bristol. Whether you're thinking of a family break, a romantic night away, a group stay or looking for a unique wedding venue, look no further! Their features include: - One master double bedroom - Two twin bedrooms - Decking area with patio furniture - Private hot tub for up to 6 people - Flat screen TV with DVD/Blu-ray player - Kitchen including microwave, dishwasher, gas over and fridge/freezer - Bed linen, duvets and towels - Double glazing and central heating - Free wi-fi - Hair dryer - Free DVD library (refundable deposit required) - High chairs and travel cots for an additional cost - Free private car parking - Easy access to Wookey Hole's caves and attractions
tagline: Revamped, restored and totally remarkable, the new Wookey Hole experience

title: The Covenstead
subtitle: The Covenstead is an amazing, magical place to stay when you visit Glastonbury.
bodyContent: The impressive building is listed, quite grand and full of curiosities and copious books on magic, myth and legend. Our location is perfect as it's on the main street with beautiful views onto the Abbey ruins and within walking distance of shops, pubs and restaurants. We also serve a mean breakfast and cater for vegetarians/vegans.

title: The Dairy at High House
subtitle: Three double bedrooms (one on the ground floor), each with either en-suite, adjacent bathroom or shower facilities.
bodyContent: South-facing kitchen and open plan living and dining area with French doors to exterior; downstairs WC. Ample parking and own area of garden. On arrival guests will find: o the fridge stocked with a few essentials: milk, bread, butter and spread o the makings of a hearty English breakfast, such as sausages, bacon, mushrooms – and of course our own hens’ new laid eggs o a cupboard with individual cereals, condiments, a small selection of herbs, spices and sauces, marmalade and locally-made jams So no need to shop on the way! Plenty of time for that when you start to explore pretty towns and villages nearby. Meanwhile relax and unwind! Tintinhull is a popular and beautiful ham stone Somerset village with the benefits of an award-winning pub and its own National Trust property as well as several others within a few miles. Easy to find, Tintinhull is just off the A303, the route to Devon and Cornwall. Here, you and your family and friends can find peace and tranquillity, while being a short distance from some of Dorset and Somerset’s pretty market towns. A little further afield lie the attractions of Bath and Bristol, mysterious Stonehenge, the West Somerset Steam Railway and coastline to the north and south. The area also benefits from good train and coach links to London.

title: The Dusthole
subtitle: Cosy and unique, The Dusthole is a must for all history buffs, anyone who relishes the quirky charms of olde worlde England and all those who are looking for somewhere memorable to stay.
bodyContent: We're not just a bed and breakfast - you can also enjoy the traditional ambience of our bar, where we serve food and drink every evening. You can sample locally brewed ales and ciders or choose from our selection of wines, carefully selected from around the globe. Formerly known as the Kings Arms, The Dusthole was originally built as the provision house for Shepton Mallet prison which, until its closure in 2013, was the oldest working prison in the UK. In the early days, inmates had to buy their own food and drink, so an enterprising governor built the provision house in order to make money out of them! In later years the provision house became a hostelry and its name changed to the Kings Arms. It is well documented that the Duke of Monmouth and his men recruited 12 ‘Sheptonians’ as they passed through the town on their way to overthrow King James II in 1685, staying nearby in Longbridge. Reputedly, after a heavy day’s march they visited the Kings Arms (no doubt taking perverse pleasure in drinking at a hostelry of that name!) to enlist new members to their cause. You may be wondering why the Kings Arms became known as The Dusthole. In the 1900s the main industries in the town were based around the local stone quarries. Workers would often call in for a drink or two on their way home, dusty from the stone they’d been working with all day, and leaving evidence of their visit as they brushed themselves off while chatting and enjoying their pint. Hence, the Kings Arms became known locally as The Dusthole. We’re lucky enough to have been visited by many celebrity guests over the years. Marco Pierre White (Chef, Hell’s Kitchen) enjoyed a cuppa, Sunday roast and a good old chat with Tony! Julian Fellowes (actor and writer) left his mark on one of our ceilings! Chris Kelly (BBC Food & Drink) is a local resident, likes to pop in for a pint. Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall (River Cottage) has been known to enjoy a sandwich or two. Adam Henson (Countryfile presenter) took a liking to our ales. Even King George V is reputed to have stayed here! Come and chat with Tony in the bar one evening and see what stories he has to tell. He's very fond of the old place and knows all its secrets!

title: The Five Dials
subtitle: We warmly welcome you to The Five Dials, our friendly (including dog friendly), family owned pub.
bodyContent: Set on the edge of the Blackdown Hills close to East Devon and West Dorset, it is an attractive and ideal location for discovering the West Country. Here, at the pub, you will also discover a buzzing and sociable atmosphere, the perfect pint and a great meal, enjoyed either by the fire or in the tranquil space of our beer garden.

title: The Flying Fish Inn
subtitle: When you stay at The Flying Fish Inn in Ashill (Windmill Hill), you'll be within the vicinity of Barrington Court. This 4-star bed & breakfast is within the region of County Cricket Ground and Muchelney Abbey.
bodyContent: Rooms Stay in one of 8 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Amenities Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as wireless Internet access (surcharge) and wedding services. Dining Enjoy a meal at a restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the bed & breakfast's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at a bar/lounge. Business, Other Amenities Free self parking is available onsite.

title: The Gables
subtitle: THE GABLES nestles in the heart of the village offering our guests peace and quiet, yet just a minutes walk to the high street with its unique local shops, pubs, restaurants, museums and galleries.
bodyContent: he Gables is perfectly situated for walking on Exmoor and the South West coastal path or finish your walk on the Coleridge Way here. There are numerous National Trust and historic properties to visit or relax on one of our nearby beaches or explore the magnificent Somerset and Devon countryside. To end your day you can relax in the cottage gardens or our guest lounge which opens out onto the cottage gardens, we have DVD`s, books and games for you to borrow. Free Wifi in all rooms. Breakfast is served in our breakfast room overlooking the courtyard garden where we offer a choice of fresh fruit, juices, cereals and a full English breakfast (made with locally sourced fresh produce where possible) or a continental breakfast. WE ARE WALKER AND DOG FRIENDLY (Dogs are only permitted in certain rooms please call before booking) VINE COTTAGE OUR SELF CATERING ACCOMODATION adjoins The Gables. Set in a cobbled court-yard, it is quietly situated and totally self contained with its own parking in the courtyard. Dog Friendly and Free WiFi. The cottage comfortably accommodates 3 - both in terms of the comfort of the beds and surrounding living space, we are able to provide a guest bed which will provide extra accommodation for second child or small adult. Breakfast is available in the main house for an extra charge. The ground floor comprises of a fully equipped kitchen (washing machine, dish washer, and all mod cons) with a light and airy open-plan dining and living area. Upstairs there is a spacious bedroom with one double and one single bed. And a large bathroom with bath and integral shower.

title: The Georgian Manor - Central Frome
subtitle: A striking boutique-style apartment within a grand Georgian manor house, this homestay has the feel of a luxury country hotel, but with the freedom of your own private bolthole in town.
bodyContent: The Georgian Manor in Frome is perfectly situated to give you the best of both worlds: it’s located just a pleasant ten minute walk from the vibrant town centre of Frome, and a short drive from scenic Somerset rambles and inspiring cultural attractions. The ideal decadent retreat for a cultural break or romantic getaway. The space The apartment is a glorious mix of old and new styles, decorated throughout with distinctive statement artwork and ornaments, while retaining the grand magnificence of the eighteenth century building. The original window shutters, cast iron radiators and ornate plasterwork echo the history of the property, while touches of modern luxury such as chandeliers, ornate mirrors and a roll top bath lend an air of opulent decadence. Enter the Georgian Manor through the grand entrance hall, or direct from your private parking area to the rear. The apartment is laid out on one level with a spacious open plan living area, which is bathed in natural light thanks to the double-aspect floor to ceiling sash windows and balcony doors. A particular highlight of the Georgian Manor is the ornate wrought iron balcony, accessed through the patio doors beyond the seating area. The balcony overlooks the communal garden area, and is the perfect place to savour a croissant and coffee for breakfast, or a Somerset sunset at dusk. A compact and well-equipped kitchen to your right boasts an integrated breakfast bar, cooker and washing machine. Chat to your friends or partner relaxing on the leather sofas while you rustle up a Frome feast of local produce. Beyond the kitchen area you will find a classically decorated bathroom, complete with Grecian-style floor tiles and a sumptuous roll top bath. And then finally, the bedroom awaits at the front of the house. After a restorative night’s sleep on the kingsize bed, in Egyptian cotton sheets on a luxurious Vispring mattress , you will wake to a room bathed in glorious sunshine from the grand sash windows. A stay at the Georgian Manor leaves you feeling relaxed and pampered by boutique-style luxury in a homely setting. Guest access The Georgian Manor is accessible via a few stone steps from ground level at the front door. The entire property is on one level, and is wheelchair accessible and suitable for guests with limited mobility. Accompanying guests are welcome to book The Luxury Georgian Apartment, which is located in the same building, which has an entrance just a few steps from that of the Georgian Manor. Other things to note Notes on our cleaning procedures For your comfort and peace of mind we are spending an extra hour at each property prior to arrival, to ensure all touch surfaces are disinfected in line with government recommendations (see here). All sheets and towels are laundered thoroughly at high temperatures with quality non-biological laundry soap.
